Introduction:
You will support the integration and commissioning of services and infrastructure for the CMS Tracker construction at CERN, with a focus on the preparation and validation of services, as well as the reception testing of components and detector assemblies. The role also includes the setup and operation of test electronics for the commissioning of detector services and the functional testing of detector components and assemblies.
Functions:

• Prepare and support the installation and commissioning of services and infrastructure for large detector assemblies (e.g. cables, racks and test setups).

• Set up and operate test electronics and commissioning setups (e.g. interlocks, sensor interfaces and thermal test configurations).

• Perform reception testing of detector substructures and components, including power distribution hardware delivered to CERN.

• Validate integrated electrical services (power, signal and grounding interfaces) installed on detector assemblies and troubleshoot issues during construction.

• Maintain traceability by updating the production database with acceptance test reports and installation data.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electronics or a related field.
Additional relevant certificates are considered an asset
Experience:

• Proficiency in the assembly, installation and wiring of electronic components (e.g. cabling, soldering, SMD components, sensors, boards).

• Hands-on experience with electrical testing and measurement techniques using laboratory and test equipment (e.g. multimeters, power supplies, oscilloscopes), including the preparation of test setups.

• Experience in maintaining laboratory equipment and inventory, updating technical databases, and documenting testing procedures and results.
Technical competencies:

• Assembly of electronic components.

• Knowledge and application of instrumentation and measurement techniques.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical/electronic systems.

• Technical documentation of electric/electronics systems.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Communicating Effectively: listening actively to others and letting others speak.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 19.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: EP-CMS-ID-2026-147-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Electronics Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a passionate Computing Engineer to join CERN's IT Storage and Data Management group (IT-SD). Our group enables large-scale data access for the laboratory, the Large Hadron Collider and CERN's broader experimental programme, managing more than one exabyte of storage in the CERN Data Centre.
You will join the CERNBox team, which provides cloud storage to the CERN community and is making CERNBox interoperable and deployable across European research infrastructures and the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) Federation. You will package, test and validate the stack using Kubernetes and Helm for deployment across on-premises and public clouds, and contribute to Reva, its Go-based backend, by implementing the Open Cloud Mesh (OCM) protocol, an emerging IETF standard for interoperable cloud storage and data sharing across institutions.
If you are excited about cloud-native systems, open standards and building software adopted by research institutions worldwide, this is the place for you!
Your responsibilities

• Develop and integrate backend software components.

• Package and deploy interoperable services in distributed environments.

• Support CERN community: you will join our operations team, troubleshooting incidents and supporting users.

• Contribute your code, features and fixes back to the CERNBox open-source projects, working alongside a broader open-source community.

• Work with partner institutions and research infrastructures across Europe to test, validate and refine these tools together.

• Support users and partner teams as they adopt these tools, helping with troubleshooting and guidance.
Your profile

• Experience, or a strong interest, in backend development and cloud-native deployment.

• Enjoys troubleshooting, hands-on problem-solving, user support and service management.

• Comfortable collaborating with external partners and international teams.

• Curiosity about system integration and interoperability challenges.
Skills

• Kubernetes and Helm chart development.

• Backend software development, in particular Go.

• Linux tech stack, administration and automation.

• Nice to have: frontend development.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-November-2026

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Field of work: Software Engineering and IT

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Se siete entusiasti di sistemi distribuiti, dati su scala exabyte e il futuro del calcolo distribuito, questo è il posto per voi.
Si lavorerà sulle tecnologie di gestione dei dati scientifici (Rucio, FTS, ...). Rucio è la piattaforma di gestione dei dati di fatto in HEP e in altre scienze, la gestione di oltre un exabyte di dati attraverso centinaia di data center in tutto il mondo.
Le esigenze di potere di calcolo sono in evoluzione, soprattutto per l'HL-LHC, e i ricercatori si affidano sempre più a supercomputer di massa e alla loro capacità di eseguire calcoli e flussi di lavoro AI.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a passionate DevOps Engineer to join the CERN IT Storage and Data Management group (IT-SD).
Our group operates the core services used by LHC and non-LHC experiments to store and manage their data, to enable data archival, reconstruction and analysis and to distribute them to archiving and computing facilities around the world (Worldwide LHC Computing Grid). The group also contributes to data management services operated in the LHC experiments.
If you are excited about distributed systems, exabyte-scale data, and the future of distributed computing, this is the place for you.
You will be working on scientific data management technologies (Rucio, FTS, ...). Rucio is the facto data management platform in HEP and other sciences, managing over one exabyte of data across hundreds of data centers worldwide.
Computing power needs are evolving, especially for the HL-LHC, and researchers are increasingly relying on massive supercomputers and their capacity to run computations and AI workflows.
To support this, Rucio is expected to act as a bridge between our distributed data systems and these remote supercomputers, ensuring datasets are moved seamlessly to where the heavy processing happens, and results flow back to the scientific community.
Your responsibilities:
You will work on a project that federates massive compute and storage resources across Europe, enabling seamless cross-border scientific collaboration.
Your key responsibilities will include:

• Connecting data to AI factories: Build integrations that allow large datasets to be easily accessed and utilised by next-generation European AI Factories and supercomputers.

• Building a storage federation: Design and validate systems that allow different data management platforms to communicate among themselves, ensuring transparent data access and policy-driven replication.

• Contributing to open source: Design robust new functionality and commit your code, features, and fixes directly back to the upstream Rucio project.

• Supporting the community: Actively participate in our Operations team to maintain infrastructure for EU projects and activities surrounding the Rucio service, including troubleshooting incidents and supporting our users.
Your profile:
Demonstrated experience in:

• Software development and integration (Python, scripting).

• Linux system administration, configuration and automation, both in baremetal and container environments (Kubernetes).

• Development tools (Git) and modern devops practices.

• Working in teams.
Skills:
We are looking for someone who enjoys problem-solving at scale and loves working in a collaborative, open-source environment.

• Strong Python programming and API design.

• Linux system administration and Kubernetes clusters.

• Solid understanding of large-scale data management, storage systems, or cloud environments.

• Familiarity with authentication mechanisms and secure data transfers is a big plus.

• A user-focused mindset and a willingness to jump into daily operations and user support.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computing Engineer (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen DevOps-Ingenieur für die CERN IT Storage and Data Management Group (IT-SD).
Unsere Gruppe betreibt die Kerndienste, die von LHC- und Nicht-LHC-Experimenten verwendet werden, um ihre Daten zu speichern und zu verwalten, Datenarchivierung, Rekonstruktion und Analyse zu ermöglichen und sie an Archivierungs- und Recheneinrichtungen auf der ganzen Welt zu verteilen (Worldwide LHC Computing Grid). Die Gruppe trägt auch zu Datenmanagementdiensten bei, die in den LHC-Experimenten betrieben werden.
Wenn Sie sich für verteilte Systeme, Exabyte-Daten und die Zukunft des verteilten Rechnens interessieren, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.
Sie arbeiten an wissenschaftlichen Datenmanagement-Technologien (Rucio, FTS, ...). Rucio ist die virtuelle Datenmanagement-Plattform in HEP und anderen Wissenschaften und verwaltet über ein Exabyte Daten in Hunderten von Rechenzentren weltweit.
Der Bedarf an Rechenleistung entwickelt sich, insbesondere für den HL-LHC, und die Forscher verlassen sich zunehmend auf massive Supercomputer und ihre Fähigkeit, Berechnungen und KI-Workflows durchzuführen.
Um dies zu unterstützen, wird erwartet, dass Rucio als Brücke zwischen unseren verteilten Datensystemen und diesen entfernten Supercomputern fungiert, um sicherzustellen, dass Datensätze nahtlos dorthin verschoben werden, wo die schwere Verarbeitung stattfindet, und die Ergebnisse an die wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft zurückfließen.
Ihre Aufgaben:
Sie werden an einem Projekt arbeiten, das umfangreiche Rechen- und Speicherressourcen in ganz Europa vereint und eine nahtlose grenzüberschreitende wissenschaftliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht.
Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

• Verbindung von Daten mit KI-Fabriken: Bauen Sie Integrationen auf, die es ermöglichen, auf große Datensätze zuzugreifen und sie von der nächsten Generation europäischer KI-Fabriken und Supercomputern zu nutzen.

• Aufbau einer Storage Federation: Konzipieren und validieren Sie Systeme, die es verschiedenen Datenmanagementplattformen ermöglichen, untereinander zu kommunizieren und so einen transparenten Datenzugriff und eine richtliniengesteuerte Replikation zu gewährleisten.

• Beitrag zu Open Source: Entwerfen Sie robuste neue Funktionen und verpflichten Sie Ihren Code, Ihre Funktionen und Korrekturen direkt an das Upstream-Rucio-Projekt.

• Unterstützung der Community: Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an unserem Operations-Team, um die Infrastruktur für EU-Projekte und Aktivitäten rund um den Rucio-Service zu erhalten, einschließlich der Fehlerbehebung und der Unterstützung unserer Benutzer.
Ihr Profil:
Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen in:

• Softwareentwicklung und -integration (Python, Scripting).

• Linux-Systemadministration, -konfiguration und -automatisierung, sowohl in Baremetal- als auch Container-Umgebungen (Kubernetes).

• Entwicklungswerkzeuge (Git) und moderne Devops-Praktiken.

• Arbeiten in Teams.
Fähigkeiten:
Wir suchen jemanden, der gerne Probleme löst und gerne in einer kollaborativen Open-Source-Umgebung arbeitet.

• Starke Python Programmierung und API Design.

• Linux Systemadministration und Kubernetes Cluster.

• Fundiertes Verständnis von groß angelegtem Datenmanagement, Speichersystemen oder Cloud-Umgebungen.

• Die Vertrautheit mit Authentifizierungsmechanismen und sicheren Datenübertragungen ist ein großes Plus.

• Eine benutzerorientierte Denkweise und die Bereitschaft, in den täglichen Betrieb und die Benutzerunterstützung einzusteigen.

You will be joining the COE section (Communication, Outreach and Education), part of the Department Infrastructure group (IT-DI). IT-DI provides services to the department ranging from the architecture and the deployment of the CERN computing facilities to the laboratory computing security and the relations with the CERN user communities and general public.
The COE section needs your help to bring the world's largest physics laboratory closer to the scientific community, to students and trainees and to the general public.
Your responsibilities

• Be part of the activities of the IT-DI-COE section in the areas of Education, Communication and Outreach.

• Take an active part in restructuring the CERN IT website: support the completion of its WordPress migration and design a new information architecture to improve searchability and usability for diverse audiences, including CERN staff, researchers, and key global initiatives like the Worldwide LHC Computing Grid.

• Support IT-DI-COE in event organisation, notably being part of the back office for the events like Conferences, Project events, CERN OpenDays (CERN IT part). This task includes the streamlining and the improvement of existing processes.

• Help building new departmental infrastructure — leveraging existing CERN repositories — to organise and maintain resources for inductions, visits, events, and other key processes, giving you the chance to shape a system from the ground up.
Your profile

• Knowledge of content management systems such as Drupal or WordPress.

• Knowledge of tools like Google Workspace, Office or equivalent.

• Knowledge of tools like Linearity, Canva or equivalent.

• Experience within scientific, research, innovation, or technology environments would be an asset.
Skills

• Ease to rapidly pick up usage of modern technologies to effectively support colleagues (e.g. organisation of meetings, negotiation with service providers, communication with persons using our infrastructure).

• Have basic knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS; familiarity with WordPress or other content-management systems is a plus, but not essential).

• Are comfortable with — or eager to learn — modern approaches to information architecture and web accessibility.

• Enjoy communicating clearly, whether in writing, through visuals, or in person.

• Be detail-oriented and comfortable handling multiple small tasks at once.

• Are a good team player who's also happy to take initiative and run with a task.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Business, Communication, Computing (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

Introduzione
Sei un ingegnere elettronico esperto e qualificato? Vuoi lavorare in una delle principali organizzazioni intergovernative scientifiche del mondo? Vieni a unire un ambiente unico il cui valore principale è l'eccellenza, e la cui caratteristica distintiva è il lavoro di squadra. CERN, partecipa!
Lavorerai in TS-Group all'interno dell'unità HSE , responsabile per la salute e la sicurezza sul lavoro, compresa la protezione dalle radiazioni, la protezione ambientale e la preparazione e la risposta di emergenza. Le attività riguardano il monitoraggio e la segnalazione degli impatti ambientali e radiologici delle attività dell’Organizzazione.
Nel vostro ruolo di ingegnere elettronico, sarete coinvolti nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento delle soluzioni di monitoraggio delle radiazioni e dell'ambiente. Questo include la partecipazione al ciclo di vita completo di hardware e sviluppo del firmware incorporato utilizzando metodologie e tecnologie moderne.
Funzioni

• Progettare e sviluppare elettronica di segnale misto, con un focus sulle interfacce dei sensori analogici e sui circuiti di misura ultra-bassa corrente.

• Sviluppare e mantenere il codice incorporato in VHDL e C per supportare il controllo del sistema, l'elaborazione dei dati e l'interfaccia hardware.

• Consolidare e mantenere il firmware eterogeneo e il suo ambiente di sviluppo (tool, costruire il flusso e sostenere l'infrastruttura).

• Adapt l'architettura MPSoC per supportare le interfacce di comunicazione richieste e l'elaborazione a bordo.

• Sviluppare e integrare gli aggiornamenti del firmware per soddisfare i requisiti funzionali e di prestazioni del sistema.

• Eseguire test funzionali per verificare il corretto comportamento del sistema in condizioni operative previste.

• Sviluppare tavole di prova elettroniche dedicate e banchi di prova complessi per valutare i sistemi elettronici sotto radiazione al CERN e alle strutture di irradiazione esterne.

• Caratterizzare nuovi sistemi attraverso attività di misura, analisi e validazione per garantire il rispetto dei requisiti funzionali e prestazionali.

• Identificare i problemi durante il test, risolvere i problemi cause root e implementare miglioramenti correttivi.

• Collabora con team hardware, firmware e software per garantire un'efficace integrazione del sistema e un funzionamento affidabile.

• Assicurare la corretta documentazione, il controllo delle versioni e la tracciabilità degli sviluppi utilizzando strumenti collaborativi come GitLab e Jira.

Laurea magistrale o dottorato o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria elettronica o di un campo relativo.

Esperienza:
Per questo post sono richiesti i seguenti:

• Sviluppo del firmware HDL complesso per FPGA, compresa l'implementazione di lettura dei dati e elaborazione dei dati, simulazione HDL, tempistica e vincoli di posizionamento.

• Software di scrittura e linguaggi di programmazione, in particolare C e Python.

• Familiarità con metodologie di progettazione digitale e flussi di verifica, con esperienza nello sviluppo ASIC.

• Conoscenza pratica delle pipeline GitLab CI/CD, tra cui automazione di costruzione, test e distribuzione.

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione elettronica mista, tra cui lo sviluppo di schede analogiche e digitali.

• Esperienza nella progettazione front-end analogica di precisione e tecniche di misura a bassa corrente.
Sono considerati beni :

• Esperienza con test di monitoraggio delle radiazioni e caratterizzazione del sistema in campi di radiazione pulsata.

• Capacità di analizzare i risultati dei test, risolvere i problemi, identificare le cause della radice e implementare miglioramenti correttivi.
Competenze tecniche:

• Progettazione e simulazione di elettronica basata su FPGA.

• Progettazione e simulazione di elettronica front-end per sensori e trasduttori analogici.

• Sviluppo di software per sistemi incorporati e in tempo reale con/senza sistema operativo.

• Conoscenza e applicazione delle tecniche di strumentazione e misura.

• Progettazione di circuiti ultra-bassi.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team.

• Conoscenza: creare o partecipare a forum per scambiare esperienze, confrontare tecniche e imparare da altri.

• Comunicare efficacemente: fornire presentazioni in modo strutturato e chiaro; regolare lo stile e il contenuto al pubblico; rispondere con calma e fiducia alle domande.

• Risultati ottenuti: dividendo lavori / progetti in sub-task gestibili con pietre miliari ben definite.

• Dimostrare la Responsabilità: lavorare in modo cosciente e affidabile; fornire promesse.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 18.08.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.
Grado di lavoro: 6-7
Riferimento del lavoro: HSE-TS-IMS-2026-161-LD
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica
Benchmark Titolo di lavoro: Ingegnere di elettronica

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!
Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
Are you a skilled and experienced electronics engineer? Do you want to work in one of the world’s leading scientific Intergovernmental Organisations? Come and join a unique environment whose core value is excellence, and whose defining characteristic is teamwork. CERN, take part!
You will work in the TS-Group within the  HSE Unit , which is responsible for occupational health and safety, including radiation protection, environmental protection, and emergency preparedness and response. Activities cover the monitoring and reporting of the environmental and radiological impacts of the Organization’s activities.
In your role as an electronics engineer, you will be involved in the development and improvement of radiation and environmental monitoring solutions. This includes participating in the full lifecycle of hardware and embedded firmware development using modern methodologies and technologies.
Functions

• Design and develop mixed-signal electronics, with a focus on analogue sensor interfaces and ultra-low-current measurement circuits.

• Develop and maintain embedded code in VHDL and C to support system control, data processing, and hardware interfacing.

• Consolidate and maintain heterogeneous firmware and its development environment (tools, build flow, and supporting infrastructure).

• Adapt the MPSoC architecture to support the required communication interfaces and onboard processing.

• Develop and integrate firmware updates to meet system functional and performance requirements.

• Perform functional tests to verify correct system behaviour under expected operating conditions.

• Develop dedicated electronic test boards and complex test benches to evaluate electronic systems under radiation at CERN and at external irradiation facilities.

• Characterise newly developed systems through measurement, analysis, and validation activities to ensure compliance with functional and performance requirements.

• Identify issues during testing, troubleshoot root causes, and implement corrective improvements.

• Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software teams to ensure effective system integration and reliable operation.

• Ensure proper documentation, version control, and traceability of developments using collaborative tools such as GitLab and Jira.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electronics Engineering or a related field.

Experience:
The following are required for this post:

• Complex HDL firmware development for FPGA, including implementation of data readout and data processing, HDL simulation, timing, and placement constraints.

• Software scripting and programming languages, particularly C and Python.

• Familiarity with digital design methodologies and verification flows, with experience in ASIC development.

• Practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, and deployment automation.

• Demonstrated experience in mixed-signal electronics design, including analogue and digital board development.

• Experience in precision analogue front-end design and low-current measurement techniques.
The following are considered assets :

• Experience with radiation monitoring tests and system characterisation under pulsed radiation fields.

• Ability to analyse test results, troubleshoot issues, identify root causes and implement corrective improvements.
Technical competencies:

• Design and simulation of FPGA-based electronics.

• Design and simulation of front-end electronics for analogue sensors and transducers.

• Development of software for embedded and real-time systems with/without OS.

• Knowledge and application of instrumentation and measurement techniques.

• Design of ultra-low-current circuits.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: creating or participating in forums to exchange experience, comparing techniques and learn from others.

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Achieving Results: dividing extensive work / projects into manageable sub-tasks with clearly defined milestones.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 18.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: HSE-TS-IMS-2026-161-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
Sind Sie ein erfahrener und erfahrener Elektronikingenieur? Möchten Sie in einer der weltweit führenden wissenschaftlichen Zwischenstaatlichen Organisationen arbeiten? Treten Sie einer einzigartigen Umgebung bei, deren Kernwert Exzellenz ist und deren definierendes Merkmal Teamarbeit ist. CERN, nehmen Sie teil!
Sie arbeiten in der TS-Group innerhalb der HSE Unit, die für den Arbeitsschutz, einschließlich Strahlenschutz, Umweltschutz und Notfallvorsorge und -reaktion verantwortlich ist. Die Aktivitäten umfassen die Überwachung und Berichterstattung über die Umwelt- und radiologischen Auswirkungen der Aktivitäten der Organisation.
In Ihrer Rolle als Elektronikingenieur sind Sie an der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Strahlungs- und Umweltüberwachungslösungen beteiligt. Dazu gehört die Teilnahme am gesamten Lebenszyklus der Hardware- und Embedded-Firmware-Entwicklung unter Verwendung moderner Methoden und Technologien.
Funktionen

• Design und Entwicklung von Mixed-Signal-Elektronik mit Schwerpunkt auf analogen Sensorschnittstellen und Ultra-Niedrigstrom-Messkreisen.

• Entwicklung und Pflege von eingebettetem Code in VHDL und C zur Unterstützung der Systemsteuerung, Datenverarbeitung und Hardwareschnittstelle.

• Konsolidieren und pflegen Sie heterogene Firmware und ihre Entwicklungsumgebung (Tools, Build-Flow und unterstützende Infrastruktur).

• Passen Sie die MPSoC-Architektur an, um die erforderlichen Kommunikationsschnittstellen und die Onboard-Verarbeitung zu unterstützen.

• Entwickeln und integrieren Sie Firmware-Updates, um die Funktions- und Leistungsanforderungen des Systems zu erfüllen.

• Führen Sie Funktionstests durch, um das korrekte Systemverhalten unter den erwarteten Betriebsbedingungen zu überprüfen.

• Entwicklung spezieller elektronischer Prüftafeln und komplexer Prüfstände zur Bewertung elektronischer Systeme unter Strahlung am CERN und an externen Bestrahlungsanlagen.

• Charakterisierung neu entwickelter Systeme durch Mess-, Analyse- und Validierungsaktivitäten, um die Einhaltung der Funktions- und Leistungsanforderungen sicherzustellen.

• Identifizieren Sie Probleme während des Tests, beheben Sie Ursachen und implementieren Sie Korrekturverbesserungen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Hardware-, Firmware- und Softwareteams zusammen, um eine effektive Systemintegration und einen zuverlässigen Betrieb zu gewährleisten.

• Gewährleistung einer ordnungsgemäßen Dokumentation, Versionskontrolle und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Entwicklungen mithilfe von kollaborativen Tools wie GitLab und Jira.

Master-Abschluss oder PhD oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Elektroniktechnik oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

Erfahrung:
Für diesen Posten ist Folgendes erforderlich:

• Komplexe HDL-Firmwareentwicklung für FPGA, einschließlich Implementierung von Datenauslesen und Datenverarbeitung, HDL-Simulation, Timing und Platzierungsbeschränkungen.

• Software-Scripting und Programmiersprachen, insbesondere C und Python.

• Vertrautheit mit digitalen Designmethoden und Verifikationsströmen, mit Erfahrung in der ASIC-Entwicklung.

• Praktische Kenntnisse der GitLab CI/CD-Pipelines, einschließlich Build-, Test- und Deployment-Automatisierung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Design von Mixed-Signal-Elektronik, einschließlich analoger und digitaler Boardentwicklung.

• Erfahrung im präzisen analogen Frontend-Design und in Niederstrom-Messtechniken.
Folgende werden als Vermögenswerte betrachtet:

• Erfahrung mit Strahlungsüberwachungstests und Systemcharakterisierung unter gepulsten Strahlungsfeldern.

• Fähigkeit, Testergebnisse zu analysieren, Probleme zu beheben, Ursachen zu identifizieren und korrigierende Verbesserungen zu implementieren.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Design und Simulation von FPGA-basierter Elektronik.

• Design und Simulation von Frontend-Elektronik für analoge Sensoren und Wandler.

• Entwicklung von Software für eingebettete und Echtzeitsysteme mit/ohne Betriebssystem.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von Mess- und Messtechniken.

• Entwurf von Ultra-Niederstromkreisen.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Arbeiten in Teams: gut in Gruppen arbeiten und sich leicht in ein Team einfügen; vollständig teilnehmen und eine aktive Rolle bei Teamaktivitäten übernehmen.

• Lernen und Teilen von Wissen: Erstellen oder Teilnahme an Foren, um Erfahrungen auszutauschen, Techniken zu vergleichen und von anderen zu lernen.

• Effektiv kommunizieren: Präsentationen auf strukturierte und klare Weise liefern; Stil und Inhalt an das Publikum anpassen; ruhig und selbstbewusst auf Fragen reagieren.

• Ergebnisse erzielen: Aufteilung umfangreicher Arbeiten / Projekte in überschaubare Teilaufgaben mit klar definierten Meilensteinen.

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: gewissenhaft und zuverlässig arbeiten; Versprechen halten.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 18.08.2026 um 23:59 Uhr erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (5 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Hybrid
Diese Position umfasst:

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.
Job Grade: 6-7
Berufsbezeichnung: HSE-TS-IMS-2026-161-LD
Arbeitsgebiet: Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik
Benchmark Job Title: Elektronikingenieur

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer zu verlängern.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!
Mehr Informationen über uns, hier: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
Êtes-vous un ingénieur en électronique compétent et expérimenté? Voulez-vous travailler dans l'une des principales organisations intergouvernementales scientifiques du monde? Venez rejoindre un environnement unique dont la valeur fondamentale est l'excellence et dont la caractéristique déterminante est le travail d'équipe. CERN, participe !
Vous travaillerez au sein du groupe TS au sein de l'unité HSE , qui est responsable de la santé et de la sécurité au travail, y compris la radioprotection, la protection de l'environnement et la préparation et l'intervention en cas d'urgence. Les activités portent sur la surveillance et la notification des incidences environnementales et radiologiques des activités de l ' Organisation.
En tant qu'ingénieur en électronique, vous participerez au développement et à l'amélioration des solutions de surveillance des rayonnements et de l'environnement. Cela inclut la participation à l'ensemble du cycle de vie du matériel et du firmware intégré au moyen de méthodologies et de technologies modernes.
Fonctions

• Concevoir et développer l'électronique à signal mixte, en mettant l'accent sur les interfaces de capteurs analogiques et les circuits de mesure à courant ultra-faible.

• Développer et maintenir le code intégré dans VHDL et C pour soutenir le contrôle du système, le traitement des données et l'interface matérielle.

• Consolider et maintenir un firmware hétérogène et son environnement de développement (outils, flux de construction et infrastructure de soutien).

• Adapter l'architecture MPSoC pour prendre en charge les interfaces de communication et le traitement embarqué requis.

• Élaborer et intégrer des mises à jour du firmware pour répondre aux exigences de fonctionnement et de performance du système.

• Effectuer des essais fonctionnels pour vérifier le comportement correct du système dans les conditions de fonctionnement prévues.

• Élaborer des planches d'essai électroniques et des bancs d'essai complexes pour évaluer les systèmes électroniques sous rayonnement au CERN et dans les installations d'irradiation externe.

• Caractériser les systèmes nouvellement développés par des activités de mesure, d'analyse et de validation afin d'assurer le respect des exigences fonctionnelles et de performance.

• Identifier les problèmes au cours des tests, résoudre les causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des améliorations correctives.

• Collaborez avec les équipes du matériel, du firmware et du logiciel pour assurer une intégration efficace du système et un fonctionnement fiable.

• Assurer la documentation, le contrôle des versions et la traçabilité des développements à l'aide d'outils collaboratifs comme GitLab et Jira.

Maîtrise ou doctorat ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine du génie électronique ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience :
Pour ce poste, il faut :

• Développement complexe de firmware HDL pour FPGA, y compris la mise en œuvre de la lecture et du traitement des données, la simulation HDL, le timing et les contraintes de placement.

• Les langages de script et de programmation, en particulier C et Python.

• Connaissance des méthodes de conception numérique et des flux de vérification, avec expérience du développement de l'ASIC.

• Connaissance pratique des pipelines CI/CD de GitLab, y compris l'automatisation de la construction, des essais et du déploiement.

• Expérience démontrée dans la conception d'électronique à signaux mixtes, y compris le développement de panneaux analogiques et numériques.

• Expérience dans la conception de l'avant analogique de précision et les techniques de mesure à faible courant.
Sont considérés comme actifs :

• Expérience des essais de surveillance des rayonnements et caractérisation du système dans les champs de rayonnement pulsé.

• Capacité d'analyser les résultats des tests, résoudre les problèmes, identifier les causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des améliorations correctives.
Compétences techniques:

• Conception et simulation de l'électronique FPGA.

• Conception et simulation de l'électronique frontale pour capteurs analogiques et transducteurs.

• Développement de logiciels pour les systèmes embarqués et en temps réel avec/sans OS.

• Connaissance et application des techniques d'instrumentation et de mesure.

• Conception de circuits ultra-low-current.
Compétences comportementales :

• Travailler en équipe : bien travailler en groupe et s'intégrer facilement dans une équipe; participer pleinement et jouer un rôle actif dans les activités de l'équipe.

• Apprendre et partager les connaissances : créer ou participer à des forums pour échanger des expériences, comparer des techniques et apprendre des autres.

• Svolgere un ruolo chiave nei gruppi di lavoro per la revisione della legislazione interna.

• Progetto di legislazione interna e relativi emendamenti.

• Fornire consulenza legale alla gestione delle risorse umane e altri stakeholder su:
• L'applicazione dello statuto e dei regolamenti e dei relativi documenti.

• Politica delle risorse umane e procedure.

• Controversie interne e procedimenti disciplinari.

• Eseguire la ricerca legale e l'analisi per la preparazione di opinioni legali, memoranda interna o corrispondenza ufficiale.

• Laurea magistrale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo del diritto, del diritto pubblico o amministrativo internazionale o di un campo correlato.
Esperienza:

Competenze tecniche:

• Redazione e scrittura di documenti ufficiali: (documenti legali ufficiali).

• Conoscenza delle regole e delle procedure amministrative: specifiche per le organizzazioni internazionali.

Competenze comportamentali:

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.

• Comunicare efficacemente: dimostrare un approccio proattivo per risolvere le differenze; affrontare le questioni di conflitto costruttivamente.

• Risolvere i problemi: identificare, definire e valutare i problemi, agire per affrontarli.

Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.

Introduzione
In qualità di ingegnere di sicurezza chimica, si unirà al reparto HSE, che supporta il CERN nell'attuazione e nell'applicazione della sua politica di sicurezza. Con il reparto HSE, si unirà al Gruppo OHS, che è responsabile di fornire consulenza, monitoraggio, e in seguito alla realizzazione e realizzazione di obiettivi di sicurezza, volti a un continuo miglioramento di un ambiente di lavoro sicuro. All'interno di questo gruppo, si unirà alla sezione General Safety and Equipment Integrity (GI).
Sarete uno degli specialisti del CERN per la sicurezza chimica, unendo un team multidisciplinare di esperti di sicurezza.
Funzioni

• Fornire consulenza e supporto, anche per le valutazioni dei rischi, nel campo della sicurezza chimica.

• Eseguire le verifiche di sicurezza sugli impianti e sulle attività.

• Fornire supporto nella definizione dei requisiti per il trasporto conforme di merci pericolose.

• Fornire supporto in controlli di sicurezza, recensioni tecniche e progetti.

• Controllare la conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza delle specifiche di ingegneria e di appalto.

• Scrivere CERN Documentazione di sicurezza con regole, istruzioni e linee guida.

• Progettazione e formazione di sicurezza in collaborazione con il servizio CERN Safety Training.

Laurea magistrale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria chimica, chimica o un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
As a Chemical Safety Engineer, you will join the HSE department, which supports CERN in the implementation and application of its Safety Policy. With the HSE department, you will join the OHS Group, which is in charge of providing advice, monitoring, and following up on the implementation and accomplishment of safety objectives, aimed at a continuous improvement of a safe working environment. Within this group, you will join the General Safety and Equipment Integrity (GI) section.
You will be one of the CERN specialists for Chemical Safety, joining a multidisciplinary team of Safety experts.
Functions

• Provide advice and support, including for risk assessments, in the Chemical Safety domain.

• Perform safety verifications on installations and activities.

• Provide support in the definition of requirements for the compliant transport of dangerous goods.

• Provide support in safety audits, technical reviews, and projects.

• Check the conformity to safety requirements of the engineering and tendering specifications.

• Write CERN Safety documentation including rules, instructions, and guidelines.

• Design and deliver safety training in collaboration with the CERN Safety Training service.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in managing chemical safety engineering aspects of large-scale industrial facilities or projects.

• Demonstrated experience in providing advice and support on chemical and biological hazards, including the transport of dangerous goods.

• Knowledge of relevant European regulations or equivalent national standards for the chemical safety domain.
Technical competencies:

• Occupational safety and risk management, knowledge of chemical risks and protection.

• Occupational safety and risk management, including hazard identification and analysis, risk assessment and compensatory measures definition.

• Knowledge of personal protective equipment.

• Safety conformity assessment.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Working in Teams: gaining trust and collaboration from others.

• Solving Problems: recognising what is essential; discriminating between important and peripheral information and being able to see the whole picture.

Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il CERN progetta, sviluppa e gestisce acceleratori di particelle e esperimenti per la ricerca scientifica per comprendere le leggi fondamentali dell'universo. Queste attività possono generare radiazioni randagi dovute all'interazione tra tra tra travi e materia. I rivelatori di radiazioni installati vicino alle varie linee e obiettivi del fascio permettono al CERN di monitorare accuratamente i livelli di radiazione. All'interno della sezione HSE-TS-IMS presso il CERN, il team è responsabile della progettazione e dello sviluppo di questa attrezzatura specializzata, nonché della sua installazione, messa in servizio, funzionamento e manutenzione.
Il monitoraggio delle radiazioni è essenziale per consentire al CERN di operare i suoi esperimenti complessi e relativi all'acceleratore, adempiendo i suoi obblighi legali per proteggere il pubblico, le persone che lavorano sul sito del CERN e l'ambiente. In questo contesto rigoroso, la sezione TS-IMS sta sviluppando una nuova generazione di ASIC per interfacciare i segnali delle camere di ionizzazione con sistemi di monitoraggio critico della sicurezza, soddisfando i requisiti di prestazioni e affidabilità difficili.
Le tue responsabilità
Si lavorerà tra un team di ingegneri e tecnici a:

• Progettare, simulare e verificare l'architettura digitale del front-end ASIC di nuova generazione.

• Preparare progetti RTL per il tapeout utilizzando flussi EDA open-source, tra cui pavimenti e preparazione di progettazione fisica.

• Supporto post-fabbricazione, caratterizzazione del sistema e validazione funzionale/prestazioni.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di integrazione analogica, verifica e SoC per garantire una compatibilità senza interruzioni del livello di sistema.
Il tuo profilo

• Esperienza pratica con flussi ASIC EDA open source (Yosys, OpenROAD, LibreLane, ecc.) da RTL a GDSII.

• Esperienza con pavimenti, definizione dei vincoli e preparazione di progettazione fisica per il tapeout.

• L'esperienza di debug del prototipo di post-tapeout è vantaggiosa.

• I contributi attivi a progetti hardware open source o toolchains EDA sono vantaggiosi.

• L'esperienza di sviluppo di sottomoduli SoC è vantaggiosa.
Competenze

• Progettazione e simulazione HDL in VHDL, Verilog o SystemVerilog.

• Buon giocatore di squadra: competenze di collaborazione tra team analogici, digitali, di verifica e SoC.

• Proficienza nei flussi di lavoro di verifica automatizzati di Git, CI/CD.

• Conoscenza dell'architettura RISC-V.

• Familiarità con l'integrazione dei segnali misti e i protocolli di interfaccia digitale.

• Comfort con ambienti di sviluppo basati su Linux e scripting per l'automazione (Python, Bash, ecc.).

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Con la scadenza dell'applicazione, si dispone di un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Elettronica (o un campo correlato) e la vostra più alta qualifica educativa è sia una laurea o master.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• I candidati senza laurea non sono ammissibili.

• I candidati con un dottorato non sono ammissibili.

Lavoro Benchmark: 200050 - Ingegnere elettronico

Vantaggi globali

descriptionByLocale.en:
CERN designs, develops, and operates particle accelerators and experiments for scientific research to understand the fundamental laws of the universe. These activities may generate stray radiation due to the interaction between beams and matter. The radiation detectors installed close to the various beam lines and targets allow CERN to accurately monitor radiation levels. Within the HSE-TS-IMS Section at CERN, the team is responsible for the design and development of this specialised equipment, as well as its installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance.
Radiation monitoring is essential to enable CERN to operate its accelerator complex and related experiments while fulfilling its legal obligations to protect the public, people working on the CERN site, and the environment. In this stringent context, the TS-IMS Section is developing a new generation of ASICs to interface ionisation chamber signals with safety-critical monitoring systems, meeting challenging performance and reliability requirements.
Your responsibilities
You will work among a team of engineers and technicians to:

• Design, simulate, and verify the digital architecture of the next-generation ASIC front-end.

• Prepare RTL designs for tapeout using open-source EDA flows, including floorplanning and physical design preparation.

• Support post-fabrication bring-up, system characterisation, and functional/performance validation.

• Collaborate closely with analogue, verification, and SoC integration teams to ensure seamless system-level compatibility.
Your profile

• Hands-on experience with open-source ASIC EDA flows (Yosys, OpenROAD, LibreLane, etc.) from RTL to GDSII.

• Experience with floorplanning, constraint definition, and physical design preparation for tapeout.

• Post-tapeout prototype bring-up and hardware debugging experience is advantageous.

• Active contributions to open-source hardware projects or EDA toolchains are advantageous.

• Experience developing SoC submodules is advantageous.
Skills

• HDL design and simulation in VHDL, Verilog, or SystemVerilog.

• Good team player: collaboration skills across analogue, digital, verification, and SoC teams.

• Proficiency in Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated verification workflows.

• Knowledge of RISC-V architecture.

• Familiarity with mixed-signal integration and digital interface protocols.

• Comfort with Linux-based development environments and scripting for automation (Python, Bash, etc.).

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electronics (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.de:
CERN entwirft, entwickelt und betreibt Teilchenbeschleuniger und Experimente für die wissenschaftliche Forschung, um die grundlegenden Gesetze des Universums zu verstehen. Diese Aktivitäten können aufgrund der Wechselwirkung zwischen Strahlen und Materie Streustrahlung erzeugen. Die in der Nähe der verschiedenen Strahlenlinien und Ziele installierten Strahlungsdetektoren ermöglichen es dem CERN, die Strahlungspegel genau zu überwachen. Innerhalb der HSE-TS-IMS-Sektion am CERN ist das Team für das Design und die Entwicklung dieser Spezialausrüstung sowie für die Installation, Inbetriebnahme, den Betrieb und die Wartung verantwortlich.
Die Strahlungsüberwachung ist unerlässlich, um das CERN in die Lage zu versetzen, seinen Beschleunigerkomplex und damit verbundene Experimente durchzuführen und gleichzeitig seinen gesetzlichen Verpflichtungen zum Schutz der Öffentlichkeit, der am CERN-Standort arbeitenden Menschen und der Umwelt nachzukommen. In diesem strengen Kontext entwickelt die TS-IMS-Sektion eine neue Generation von ASICs, um Ionisationskammersignale mit sicherheitskritischen Überwachungssystemen zu verbinden und anspruchsvolle Leistungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsanforderungen zu erfüllen.
Ihre Verantwortung

• Design, Simulation und Verifizierung der digitalen Architektur des ASIC-Frontends der nächsten Generation.

• Erfahrung mit Bodenplanung, Einschränkungsdefinition und physischer Designvorbereitung für Tapeout.

• Post-Tapeout Prototyp Bring-up und Hardware-Debugging-Erfahrung ist vorteilhaft.

• Aktive Beiträge zu Open-Source-Hardwareprojekten oder EDA-Toolchains sind vorteilhaft.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SoC-Submodulen ist vorteilhaft.
Fähigkeiten

• HDL-Design und Simulation in VHDL, Verilog oder SystemVerilog.

• Guter Teamplayer: Zusammenarbeit in analogen, digitalen, Verifizierungs- und SoC-Teams.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le CERN conçoit, développe et exploite des accélérateurs de particules et des expériences de recherche scientifique pour comprendre les lois fondamentales de l'univers. Ces activités peuvent générer des rayonnements parasites en raison de l'interaction entre les faisceaux et la matière. Les détecteurs de rayonnement installés près des différentes lignes et cibles de faisceau permettent au CERN de surveiller avec précision les niveaux de rayonnement. Au sein de la section HSE-TS-IMS du CERN, l'équipe est responsable de la conception et du développement de cet équipement spécialisé, ainsi que de son installation, de sa mise en service, de son fonctionnement et de sa maintenance.
La surveillance des rayonnements est essentielle pour permettre au CERN d'exploiter son complexe d'accélérateurs et ses expériences connexes tout en remplissant ses obligations légales de protection du public, des personnes travaillant sur le site du CERN et de l'environnement. Dans ce contexte rigoureux, la Section TS-IMS développe une nouvelle génération d'ASIC permettant d'interfacer les signaux des chambres d'ionisation avec des systèmes de surveillance critiques en matière de sécurité, répondant aux exigences de performance et de fiabilité difficiles.
Vos responsabilités
Vous travaillerez parmi une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens pour :

• Concevoir, simuler et vérifier l'architecture numérique du front-end ASIC de prochaine génération.

• Préparer des modèles RTL pour la dématérialisation à l'aide de flux EDA à source ouverte, y compris la planification du plancher et la préparation de la conception physique.

• Soutenir l'apport post-fabrication, la caractérisation du système et la validation fonctionnelle/performance.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'intégration analogique, de vérification et de SoC pour assurer une compatibilité sans faille au niveau du système.
Votre profil

• Expérience pratique des flux ASIC EDA open source (Yosys, OpenROAD, LibreLane, etc.) de RTL à GDSII.

• Expérience de la planification des planchers, de la définition des contraintes et de la préparation de la conception physique pour le ruban adhésif.

• L'expérience de débogage du prototype post-enregistrement est avantageuse.

• Les contributions actives à des projets matériels open-source ou à des chaînes d'outils EDA sont avantageuses.

• L'expérience du développement des sous-modules SoC est avantageuse.
Compétences

• Conception et simulation HDL en VHDL, Verilog ou SystemVerilog.

• Bon joueur d'équipe : compétences en collaboration entre équipes analogiques, numériques, de vérification et SoC.

• Connaissance des pipelines Git, CI/CD et des processus de vérification automatisés.

• Connaissance de l'architecture RISC-V.

• Familiarité avec intégration mixte et protocoles d'interface numérique.

• Confort avec les environnements de développement basés sur Linux et scripts pour l'automatisation (Python, Bash, etc.).

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• À la date limite d'inscription, vous disposez d'un maximum de deux ans d'expérience professionnelle depuis votre diplôme en électronique (ou dans un domaine connexe) et votre plus haute qualification est soit un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

• Les candidats sans diplôme universitaire ne sont pas admissibles.

Introduzione

Il Dipartimento di Ingegneria (EN) spinge avanti i limiti della tecnologia affinché i fisici possano svolgere la loro ricerca. All'interno del reparto EN, il gruppo di raffreddamento e ventilazione (EN-CV) è responsabile della progettazione, della costruzione, del funzionamento e della manutenzione degli impianti di raffreddamento e ventilazione per i grandi acceleratori di fisica energetica, esperimenti e impianti tecnici. Il gruppo di EN-CV persegue sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione sostenibili migliorando il risparmio energetico e il recupero.

Vi unirete alla Sezione Metodi, Store ed Elettrica (CES), che supervisiona il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei sistemi di trattamento delle acque, nonché lo sviluppo di procedure di manutenzione, l'implementazione della gestione computerizzata della manutenzione (CMMS), la gestione della documentazione, la gestione dei pezzi di ricambio e le opere elettriche.

Siete qualificati e proattivi e specializzati in impianti di trattamento acque industriali, pronti a contribuire a un ambiente di lavoro unico nel cuore di una delle installazioni scientifiche più complesse del mondo?

In questo ruolo, contribuirete all'analisi, all'ottimizzazione e allo sviluppo dei sistemi di trattamento delle acque utilizzati per impianti di raffreddamento e ventilazione. Garantirete prestazioni del sistema, affidabilità e conformità ai requisiti ambientali e di sicurezza, supportando al contempo le attività di funzionamento e manutenzione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
The Engineering Department (EN) pushes forward the limits of technology so that physicists can carry out their research. Within the EN department, the Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) group is responsible for the design, the construction, the operation and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy savings and recovery.

You will join the Methods, Store and Electrical Section (CES), which oversees the operation and maintenance of water treatment systems, as well as the development of maintenance procedures, implementation of computerised maintenance management (CMMS), documentation management, spare parts store management and electrical works.

Are you a qualified and proactive and specialised in industrial water treatment systems, ready to contribute to a unique working environment at the heart of one of the world's most complex scientific installations?

In this role, you will contribute to the analysis, optimisation and development of water treatment systems used for cooling and ventilation installations. You will ensure system performance, reliability and compliance with environmental and safety requirements, while supporting operation and maintenance activities.
Functions

• Study, design and validate the performance of new water treatment installations or upgrade of existing water treatment installations.

• Contribute to the water treatment contract management, produce technical specification and all the documents for the tendering procedure for the renewal of the contract.

• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring issues affecting water treatment systems.

• Plan, coordinate and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities (by using the CMMS system), defining appropriate strategies and ensuring alignment with operational needs.

• Monitor system performance and follow up on activities, ensuring reporting on progress, schedule and costs.

• Technically coordinate contractors’ activities for maintenance and installation work, ensuring compliance with contractual clauses, technical standards and safety requirements.

• Ensure that technical documentation is complete, structured and up to date, in line with quality standards.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering or a related field or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in the operation, maintenance and optimisation of water treatment systems, including demineralised water production.

• Proven experience in water treatment of cooling circuits (cooling towers or closed circuits), including water chemistry aspects.

• Experience in the technical coordination of external contractors and activities.

• Experience in the use of CMMS tools.

• Experience in low-voltage electrical systems.

• Experience in analysing and troubleshooting technical systems would be an asset.

• Experience in contract management, would be an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems and networks.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Design and construction of cooling water systems.

• Operation and maintenance of HVAC plants and networks.

• Work Technical supervision of contractor.

• Work site supervision.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 16.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to asbestos.

• Exposure to lead.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 4-5
Job reference: EN-CV-CES-2026-124-LD
Field of work: Material and Surface Science
Benchmark Job Title: Material Science/Chemical Technical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
