descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous rejoindrez la section Outils et services du Service d'information scientifique, l'équipe responsable des plateformes qui alimentent la découverte scientifique et l'accès libre dans la communauté de la physique en haute énergie. Nos systèmes comprennent INSPIRE, le pôle mondial de la littérature pour la physique des particules; SCOAP3, qui finance et suit l'édition en libre accès; CERN Analysis Preservation, qui protège les analyses derrière les résultats de la physique; et un outil facilitant l'accès à la mémoire institutionnelle du CERN.
En tant que Backend Python Engineer, vous concevez, construisez et exploitez les services qui ingèrent, curent, recherchent et exposent des millions de documents scientifiques à un public mondial. Vous travaillerez sur les pipelines de données à haut débit, les API REST, l'infrastructure de recherche et l'intégration de la récupération par l'IA dans les systèmes de production. Votre code sera open source et utilisé quotidiennement par des chercheurs de centaines d'instituts.
Dans le cadre de l'équipe Outils et Services, vous piloterez la modernisation et l'évolution de la plateforme de contenu du Service d'information scientifique. Vous avancerez les services de backend derrière INSPIRE, SCOAP3 et CERN Analysis Preservation, développerez les services Model Context Protocol qui ouvrent le contenu scientifique de l'équipe aux clients AI, et évaluerez l'harmonisation du backend INSPIRE avec la nouvelle pile backoffice. Il s'agit d'un projet défini pour renforcer la découverte, l'interopérabilité et l'accès à l'IA de la plateforme.
Vos responsabilités

• La responsabilité principale de ce poste est de piloter la modernisation du moteur INSPIRE, d'élargir les services de protocole de contexte modèle de l'équipe et d'aligner les services de numérisation et d'archivage sur la pile technologique de l'équipe, en assurant une migration à grande échelle vers le service Accès à la mémoire (AtoM).
INSPIRE moteur et harmonisation:

• Examinez les autres récoltes sur mesure, environ 1000, et migrez celles qui devraient être conservées à Apache Airflow, en prenant sa retraite ou en repensant le reste.

• Travailler avec les conservateurs tout au long pour décider ce qu'il faut garder, et automatiser le pipeline où l'évaluation montre qu'il ajoute de la valeur, en maintenant un humain dans la boucle pour les décisions qui exigent un jugement expert.

• Évoluer les pipelines d'ingestion et de curation d'air Apache qui traitent les métadonnées scientifiques et le texte intégral à l'échelle, améliorant la qualité des données, la duplication, l'enrichissement et la couverture des sources.
Accès à l'IA et interopérabilité:

• Élargir les services du protocole de contexte modèle de l'équipe à l'ensemble de l'INSPIRE, de la bibliothèque et d'autres services de l'équipe, en les transférant du projet pilote à une interface cohérente, documentée et durable qui ouvre le contenu scientifique curé aux clients externes de l'IA.

• Développez et optimisez les fonctionnalités de recherche et de découverte sur OpenSearch qui sous-tendent ces fonctionnalités, y compris l'accord de pertinence et les stratégies d'indexation.
Services de numérisation et d'archivage:

• Aligner les services de numérisation et d'archivage sur la pile technologique de l'équipe, les moderniser sur des cadres communs et des outils de déploiement.

• Fournir et superviser la migration de 35 000 nouveaux objets d'archives vers le service Accès à la mémoire (AtoM) en 2027, en maintenant la qualité des métadonnées et des données tout au long.

• Développer et automatiser la connexion entre les services connectés, permettant ainsi au contenu de circuler de manière fiable dans les systèmes de numérisation et d'archivage.

• Préparer les pipelines d'ingestion pour l'ingestion de nouveaux dossiers, en les harmonisant avec les autres applications de l'équipe.
Fondations techniques :

• Conception, documentation et livraison des API REST consommées par les applications internes, les instituts partenaires et les outils tiers.

• Appliquer les tests automatisés, l'examen des codes, la surveillance et l'IC et le CD, et soutenir la production par des déploiements containerizzato et le réglage des performances.

• Contribuer les extrants de l'équipe à la communauté open source pour faire progresser la science ouverte.
Votre profil

• Expérience démontrée construction et exploitation de services de backend en Python dans un environnement de production. Un bilan solide avec des cadres Web tels que Django, Flask ou FastAPI et avec des bases de données relationnelles et documentaires.

• Mains sur l'expérience de conception des API REST.

• Expérience pratique avec les moteurs de recherche tels que OpenSearch, y compris l'indexation et la pertinence.

• Familiarité avec les déploiements containerizzato, contrôle de version avec les flux de travail Git et CI et CD.

• L'expérience qui a contribué aux projets open source et qui a travaillé dans une équipe d'ingénierie collaborative est très appréciée.
Compétences

• Forte compétence en Python et les pratiques modernes de développement de backend, y compris des cadres tels que Django, Flask et FastAPI.

• Une bonne compréhension de la conception de l'API REST, de la programmation asynchrone et des tests logiciels.

• Expérience avec des magasins de données SQL comme PostgreSQLTM et avec des technologies de recherche comme OpenSearch.

• Connaissance pratique des pipelines Docker, Kubernetes et CI et CD.

• Comprendre les normes de métadonnées et le traitement à grande échelle des données.

• Capacité d'écrire un code propre, bien documenté et à jour.

• Compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et attention aux détails.

• Capacité de travailler dans une équipe multiculturelle et dans une mentalité collaborative et axée sur la propriété.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en informatique (ou dans un domaine connexe) et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;

• ou d'un doctorat d'une durée maximale de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

Avantages globaux

• Une allocation mensuelle entre 6372-004 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.

Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible !
Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.
Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

Stiamo cercando un ingegnere tecnico di controllo elettrico focalizzato su sistemi di controllo industriale e infrastrutture SCADA in un ambiente di ingegneria elettrica. Si supporta l'installazione, l'ingegneria, il cablaggio, la configurazione, la messa in servizio e la manutenzione di sistemi di controllo e monitoraggio elettrici utilizzati per supervisionare la rete di distribuzione elettrica CERN per HL-LHC . L'attrezzatura tipica comprende convertitori di potenza e segnale, interruttori di rete, unità terminali remoti (RTU), unità di ingresso/uscita remoti, bus di comunicazione e dispositivi di campo.
In qualità di tecnico di controllo elettrico nel gruppo di ingegneria elettrica, contribuirai attivamente all'installazione, all'ingegneria, al cablaggio e alla messa in servizio di apparecchiature di controllo, inclusi convertitori di potenza e segnale, interruttori di rete, unità di acquisizione remota e unità terminali necessarie per la supervisione di apparecchiature elettriche, nell'ambito di un sistema SCADA per la supervisione della rete elettrica CERN. Il lavoro richiederà anche il coordinamento dei tecnici degli appaltatori per le attività in loco, la diagnosi e la risoluzione dei problemi delle apparecchiature di controllo e dei guasti dei bus di comunicazione, la produzione di documentazione tecnica e report rilevanti.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Installazione e messa in servizio di apparecchiature di controllo industriale (stazioni di I/O remoto, interruttori, timeserver, gateway di protocollo..) e di apparecchiature elettriche integrate nel sistema di controllo e supervisione.

• Configurazione di SCADA e sistemi di acquisizione dati.

• Preparazione di file tecnici per il cablaggio patch-panel e il cablaggio remoto della stazione I/O.

• Supervisione del personale di appalto per attività di cablaggio e installazione del cantiere.
Il tuo profilo:

• Conoscenza pratica dimostrata nell'installazione e nella messa in servizio di apparecchiature di controllo industriale.

• Esecuzione e supervisione del cablaggio del segnale, test funzionali.

• Risoluzione dei problemi dei controlli guasti hardware.

• Conoscenza pratica dei protocolli di comunicazione industriale, impostazione e risoluzione dei problemi (ad esempio Modbus TCP/IP , IEC 60870-5-104, IEC-61850...).

• Coordinamento degli appaltatori per attività di cantiere e di ingegneria dei dati.

• Conoscenza pratica del cablaggio elettrico di base, la lettura di schemi elettrici e l'utilizzo di multimetri.
Competenze:

• Conoscenza dell'installazione, dell'ingegneria e dei test di SCADA e dei sistemi di acquisizione.

• Conoscenza della risoluzione dei problemi del fieldbus seriale o Ethernet.

• Conoscenza di base nella programmazione dei sistemi PLC.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Con il termine di applicazione, hai un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Ingegneria elettrica / industriale (o un campo correlato) e la tua più alta qualifica educativa è un diploma di istruzione secondaria generale.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• I candidati con una laurea, Master o dottorato di ricerca non sono ammissibili.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for an Electrical Controls Technical Engineer focused on industrial control systems and SCADA infrastructure in an electrical engineering environment. You would support the installation, engineering, cabling, configuration, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical control and monitoring systems used to supervise CERN electrical distribution network for HL-LHC . Typical equipment includes power and signal converters, network switches, Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), remote input/output units, communication buses and field devices.
As Electrical Controls technician in the Electrical Engineering Group, you will actively contribute to the installation, engineering, cabling and commissioning of controls equipment, including power and signal converters, network switches, remote acquisition units and terminal units required for the supervision of electrical equipment, as part of a SCADA system for the supervision of the CERN electrical power network. The job will also require coordination of contractor technicians for on-site activities, diagnosis and troubleshooting of controls equipment and communication bus faults, production of relevant technical documentation and reports.
Your responsibilities:

• Installation and commissioning of industrial controls equipment (WAGO remote I/O stations, switches, timeservers, protocol gateways..) and of electrical equipment integrated in the control and supervision system.

• Configuration of SCADA and data acquisition systems.

• Preparation of technical files for patch-panel cabling and remote I/O station wiring.

• Supervision of contractor personnel for work-site cabling and installation activities.
Your profile:

• Demonstrated practical knowledge in installation and commissioning of industrial controls equipment.

• Execution and supervision of signal cabling, functional testing.

• Troubleshooting of controls hardware faults.

• Practical knowledge of industrial communication protocols, setting and troubleshooting (e.g. Modbus TCP/IP , IEC 60870-5-104, IEC-61850...).

• Coordination of contractors for work-site and data engineering activities.

• Practical knowledge of basic electrical wiring, reading electrical schematics and using multimeters.
Skills:

• Knowledge of installation, engineering and testing of SCADA and acquisition systems.

• Knowledge of serial or Ethernet based fieldbus troubleshooting.

• Basic knowledge in programming of PLC systems.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical / Industrial Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

Vous prendrez en charge l'installation, l'ingénierie, le câblage, la configuration, la mise en service et l'entretien des systèmes de commande et de surveillance électriques utilisés pour superviser le réseau de distribution électrique du CERN pour HL-LHC. L'équipement typique comprend les convertisseurs de puissance et de signal, les commutateurs réseau, les unités terminaux à distance (UTR), les unités d'entrée/sortie à distance, les bus de communication et les dispositifs de terrain.
En tant que technicien des commandes électriques du Groupe de l'ingénierie électrique, vous participerez activement à l'installation, à l'ingénierie, au câblage et à la mise en service des équipements de commande, y compris les convertisseurs de puissance et de signal, les commutateurs réseau, les unités d'acquisition à distance et les unités terminales nécessaires à la supervision des équipements électriques, dans le cadre d'un système SCADA pour la supervision du réseau électrique du CERN. Ce travail nécessitera également la coordination des techniciens contractuels pour les activités sur place, le diagnostic et le dépannage du matériel de contrôle et des pannes d'autobus de communication, la production de documents techniques et de rapports pertinents.
Vos responsabilités :

• Installation et mise en service d'équipements de commande industrielle (postes d'E/S à distance, commutateurs, serveurs de temps, passerelles de protocole) et d'équipements électriques intégrés dans le système de contrôle et de supervision.

• Configuration des systèmes SCADA et d'acquisition de données.

• Préparation de fichiers techniques pour le câblage de panneaux de patch et le câblage de station d'E/S à distance.

• Supervision du personnel de l'entrepreneur pour les activités de câblage et d'installation sur chantier.
Votre profil:

• Connaissances pratiques démontrées en matière d'installation et de mise en service d'équipements de contrôle industriel.

• Exécution et supervision du câblage des signaux, essais fonctionnels.

• Dépannage des défauts matériels de contrôle.

• Connaissance pratique des protocoles de communication industrielle, de réglage et de dépannage (p. ex. Modbus TCP/IP , CEI 60870-5-104, CEI-61850...).

• Coordination des entrepreneurs pour les activités de chantier et d'ingénierie des données.

• Connaissance pratique du câblage électrique de base, lecture des schémas électriques et utilisation de multimètres.
Compétences :

• Connaissance de l'installation, de l'ingénierie et des essais des systèmes SCADA et d'acquisition.

• Connaissance du dépannage des bus de terrain en série ou Ethernet.

• Connaissances de base dans la programmation des systèmes PLC.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• À la date limite de présentation des candidatures, vous disposez d'un maximum de deux ans d'expérience professionnelle depuis votre diplôme en génie électrique/industriel (ou dans un domaine connexe) et votre diplôme d'études supérieures est un diplôme d'enseignement secondaire général.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

• Les candidats titulaires d'un baccalauréat, d'une maîtrise ou d'un doctorat ne sont pas admissibles.

In this role, you will contribute to a major upgrade program of CERN's accelerator complex by maintaining, replacing, and installing beam instrumentation systems. Your day-to-day work involves removing and installing equipment components across accelerator facilities, tracking interventions using CERN's management tools, and coordinating on-site progress with engineers and technicians
Your responsibilities

• Remove equipment components for refurbishment or replacement.

• Install new instrumentation systems and upgrades throughout the accelerator complex.

• Track your tasks using CERN's management tools and provide updates in team meetings.

• Coordinate with engineers, technicians, and other groups to keep everyone informed of on-site progress.

• Work across different areas of CERN's accelerator facilities, following all safety protocols and ensuring precise, clean execution of technical interventions.
Your profile

• Comfortable using standard hand tools and basic technical equipment.

• No prior experience with particle accelerators or beam instrumentation required. We will train you on CERN-specific systems.
Skills

• Quick learner comfortable adapting to new tools, procedures, and technical environments.

• Attention to detail and careful approach when working with sensitive electronic and electromechanical equipment.

• Good communicator who works well with diverse technical teams.

• Practical problem-solving mindset.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical or Electrical (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il 3D Integration Office, parte del gruppo EN-ACE del CERN, coordina le attività di integrazione per il terzo Long Shutdown (LS3), un importante programma che definisce il futuro del complesso acceleratore.
In questo ruolo, si coordina un team multidisciplinare di designer, supervisionare complessi studi di integrazione 3D e guidare il miglioramento continuo dei processi di qualità dei dati. Lavorando al centro di uno dei più ambiziosi programmi di ingegneria del CERN, collaborerete con diversi esperti tecnici e contribuirete alla riuscita integrazione di sistemi avanzati in un ambiente altamente internazionale.
Le tue responsabilità

• Coordinare, monitorare e seguire gli studi di integrazione 3D supportando il terzo Long Shutdown (LS3) del complesso acceleratore CERN.

• Collabora con team multidisciplinari durante le attività di installazione e manutenzione in loco per identificare e risolvere i problemi di integrazione.

• Preparare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica, aggiornare le informazioni di progetto nelle piattaforme IT interne (ad esempio Track It, EDMS), e sviluppare dashboard per supportare il monitoraggio e il processo decisionale del progetto.

• Creare, aggiornare e mantenere modelli 3D utilizzando CATIA V5 per garantire dati di integrazione accurati e affidabili.

• Contribuisci a migliorare la qualità dei dati CAD all'interno dell'ambiente PDM/PLM e supporta robusti flussi di lavoro di convalida dell'integrazione 3D.

• Aiuta a sviluppare e standardizzare i processi di integrazione 3D, le metodologie e le migliori pratiche in tutto l'Ufficio di integrazione.

• Verifica riferimenti meccanici e magnetici in stretta collaborazione con il team Layout and Configuration Management.

• Sostenere l'organizzazione e la relazione delle riunioni del comitato di integrazione, promuovere una comunicazione efficace e un coordinamento tra gli stakeholder.

• Coordinate le attività di scansione laser con i team di rilevamento e pianificazione, garantendo una pianificazione efficiente, il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza e la preparazione delle autorizzazioni di accesso.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The 3D Integration Office, part of CERN's EN-ACE group, coordinates integration activities for the third Long Shutdown (LS3), a major programme shaping the future of the accelerator complex.
In this role, you will coordinate a multidisciplinary team of designers, oversee complex 3D integration studies, and drive continuous improvement of data quality processes. Working at the core of one of CERN's most ambitious engineering programmes, you will collaborate with diverse technical experts and contribute to the successful integration of advanced systems in a highly international environment.
Your responsibilities

• Coordinate, monitor and follow up 3D integration studies supporting the third Long Shutdown (LS3) of the CERN accelerator complex.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams during on-site installation and maintenance activities to identify and resolve integration issues.

• Prepare and maintain technical documentation, update project information in internal IT platforms (e.g. Track It, EDMS), and develop dashboards to support project monitoring and decision-making.

• Create, update and maintain 3D models using CATIA V5 to ensure accurate and reliable integration data.

• Contribute to improving the quality of CAD data within the PDM/PLM environment and support robust 3D integration validation workflows.

• Help develop and standardise 3D integration processes, methodologies and best practices across the Integration Office.

• Verify mechanical and magnetic references in close collaboration with the Layout and Configuration Management team.

• Support the organisation and reporting of Integration Committee meetings, fostering effective communication and coordination between stakeholders.

• Coordinate laser scanning activities with survey and scheduling teams, ensuring efficient planning, compliance with safety requirements and preparation of access authorisations.

• Develop and maintain collaborative web workspaces to centralise information, facilitate knowledge sharing and strengthen communication within the Integration Office and with project stakeholders.
More information here .
Your profile

• Mechanical, industrial, systems or integration engineering.

• Organising and managing technical data using digital engineering or information management tools.

• Preparing clear technical documentation and presenting engineering information in a structured and accessible way.

• Coordinating technical activities involving multiple stakeholders and managing priorities effectively.

• Working with PDM/PLM environments or engineering data management systems is an advantage.
Skills

• 3D CAD modelling skills, preferably using CATIA V5 or an equivalent CAD software.

• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, installation constraints and 3D integration principles.

• Interest in process improvement, standardisation and engineering quality.

• Ability to analyse technical issues and propose practical solutions in a collaborative environment.

• Excellent organisational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage several tasks simultaneously.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione: Vi invitiamo a portare la vostra carriera a un nuovo livello emozionante, unendo il team di operatori che gestiscono il complesso acceleratore CERN dal CERN Control Centre (CCC ). Il Gruppo Operazioni è responsabile dello sfruttamento dell'intero complesso di acceleratori CERN e delle sue infrastrutture tecniche, tra cui il Large Hadron Collider (LHC), che gestisce un ricco programma sperimentale protone, antiprotone e ioni pesanti. Sarete al centro della preparazione e della consegna di travi di particelle ai diversi programmi di fisica del CERN. Quando non si utilizzano queste macchine complesse, si contribuirà allo sviluppo di applicazioni e strumenti avanzati per supportare e migliorare il funzionamento. Funzioni:
• Partecipa al team di turni 24/7 che gestisce il complesso acceleratore del CERN.
• Operare protoni e/o acceleratori ioni (Linac3, Linac4, PSB, LEIR e/o PS) e le linee di trave alle strutture sperimentali associate su base a turni, garantendo l'esecuzione sicura e tempestiva del programma di fisica e ottenendo gli obiettivi definiti di performance del fascio.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i fisici dell'acceleratore per impostare e ottimizzare il funzionamento dell'acceleratore e progettare, documentare, commissionare e ottimizzare vari scenari operativi.
• Partecipa allo sviluppo di applicazioni e strumenti avanzati come parte di un team o in collaborazione con ingegneri o fisici all'interno del gruppo OP o all'interno di un gruppo di attrezzature specializzate.
• Al di fuori dei periodi di funzionamento dell'acceleratore, assistere il team di infrastrutture tecniche con il funzionamento dell'infrastruttura tecnica del CERN o di altri gruppi di apparecchiature CERN, se necessario.
• Diploma tecnico o amministrativo superiore o equivalente nel campo dell'amministrazione, dell'ingegneria informatica, dell'analisi dei dati (non esaustiva) o di un campo relativo. Esperienza:
• Esperienza di lavoro iniziale in un ambiente tecnico o scientifico.
• Esperienza nel campo della fisica, dell'ingegneria o dell'informatica.
• Conoscenza di base dell'ingegneria del software in un ambiente di linguaggio di sviluppo moderno.
• Familiarità con concetti e tecniche di automazione, con l'interesse di migliorare l'efficienza operativa e l'affidabilità.
• Guidare a lavorare in collaborazione in un team multidisciplinare e contribuire a continui miglioramenti operativi.
• L'esperienza nel campo delle grandi strutture operative e del loro hardware associato (ad esempio dispositivi di misura, tecniche di convertitore di potenza, apparecchiature di vuoto, PLC, lavoro in aree di radiazione controllate, ecc.) sarebbe un bene. Competenze tecniche:
• Operazione degli acceleratori.
• Analisi e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni di acceleratore.
• Test e validazione dei componenti del rilevatore, dell'acceleratore e della linea del fascio.
• Conoscenza delle tecniche di programmazione e delle lingue.
• Sviluppo del software di applicazione. Competenze comportamentali:

Introduction:
We invite you to take your career to an exciting new level by joining the team of operators who run the CERN accelerator complex from the CERN Control Centre ( CCC ). The Operations Group is responsible for the exploitation of the entire CERN accelerator complex and its technical infrastructure, including the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), running a rich proton, antiproton and heavy ion experimental programme. You will be at the heart of the preparation and delivery of particle beams to the different physics programs at CERN. When not operating these complex machines, you will contribute to the development of applications and advanced tools to support and improve operation.
Functions:

• Take part in the 24/7 shift team which runs CERN's accelerator complex.

• Operate proton and/or ion accelerators (Linac3, Linac4, PSB, LEIR and/or PS) and the beam lines to the associated experimental facilities on a shift basis, ensuring the safe and timely execution of the physics schedule and obtaining the defined beam performance goals.

• Work closely with accelerator physicists to set up and optimise the accelerator operation and to design, document, commission and optimise various operational scenarios.

• Participate in the development of applications and advanced tools as part of a team or in collaboration with engineers or physicists within the OP group or within a specialised equipment group.

• Outside periods of accelerator operation, assist the technical infrastructure team with the operation of CERN's technical infrastructure or other CERN equipment groups, if required.

• Higher Technical or Administrative Diploma or equivalent in the field of Administration, Computer Engineering, Data Analysis (non-exhaustive) or a related field.
Experience:

• Initial work experience in a technical or scientific environment.

• Experience in the field of physics, engineering or computing.

• Basic knowledge of software engineering in a modern development language environment.

• Familiarity with automation concepts and techniques, with an interest in improving operational efficiency and reliability.

• Drive to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and contribute to continuous operational improvements.

• Experience in the field of operating large facilities and their associated hardware (e.g. measurement devices, power converter techniques, vacuum equipment, PLCs, work in controlled radiation areas, etc.) would be an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Operation of accelerators.

• Analysis and optimisation of accelerator performance.

• Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.

• Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.

• Development of application software.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: cooperating constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balancing personal goals with team goals.

• Managing Self: taking initiative beyond regular tasks and making things happen.

• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.

• Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 29.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Shift work, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• A valid driving licence.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: BE-OP-PSB-2026-141-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Accelerator/Industrial Process Operations Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

Introduction: Nous vous invitons à prendre votre carrière à un nouveau niveau passionnant en rejoignant l'équipe d'opérateurs qui dirigent le complexe d'accélérateur du CERN du Centre de contrôle du CERN (CCC). Le Groupe des opérations est responsable de l'exploitation de l'ensemble du complexe d'accélérateurs du CERN et de son infrastructure technique, y compris le Grand Collider Hadron (LHC), qui gère un riche proton, un antiproton et un programme expérimental d'ions lourds. Vous serez au cœur de la préparation et de la livraison de faisceaux de particules aux différents programmes de physique du CERN. Lorsque vous n'utilisez pas ces machines complexes, vous contribuerez au développement d'applications et d'outils avancés pour soutenir et améliorer le fonctionnement. Fonctions:
• Participez à l'équipe 24/7 qui dirige le complexe d'accélérateurs du CERN.
• Exploiter des accélérateurs de protons et/ou d'ions (Linac3, Linac4, PSB, LEIR et/ou PS) et les lignes de faisceaux vers les installations expérimentales associées par quart, en assurant l'exécution sûre et en temps opportun du programme de physique et en obtenant les objectifs de performance de faisceau définis.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les physiciens d'accélérateurs pour mettre en place et optimiser le fonctionnement de l'accélérateur et concevoir, documenter, commander et optimiser divers scénarios opérationnels.
• Participer au développement d'applications et d'outils avancés dans le cadre d'une équipe ou en collaboration avec des ingénieurs ou des physiciens au sein du groupe OP ou d'un groupe d'équipement spécialisé.
• En dehors des périodes de fonctionnement de l'accélérateur, assister l'équipe d'infrastructure technique dans le fonctionnement de l'infrastructure technique du CERN ou d'autres groupes d'équipement du CERN, si nécessaire.
• Diplôme technique ou administratif supérieur ou équivalent dans le domaine de l'administration, du génie informatique, de l'analyse des données (non exhaustive) ou dans un domaine connexe. Expérience :
• Expérience professionnelle initiale dans un environnement technique ou scientifique.
• Expérience en physique, en ingénierie ou en informatique.
• Connaissance de base de l'ingénierie logicielle dans un environnement linguistique de développement moderne.
• Familiarisation avec les concepts et les techniques d'automatisation, avec un intérêt pour l'amélioration de l'efficacité opérationnelle et de la fiabilité.
• Favoriser la collaboration au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire et contribuer à des améliorations opérationnelles continues.
• L'expérience acquise dans le domaine de l'exploitation de grandes installations et de leur matériel connexe (p. ex. dispositifs de mesure, techniques de convertisseur de puissance, équipement sous vide, CPL, travaux dans des zones de rayonnement contrôlé, etc.) serait un atout. • Connaissance des techniques de programmation et des langues.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La sezione Radioactive Beam Production (SY-STI-RBP) è alla ricerca di uno scienziato materiale, ingegnere dei materiali, chimico o specialista correlato per contribuire allo sviluppo di materiali target di prossima generazione per la produzione di fasci ioni radioattivi presso lo stabilimento ISOLDE. Come laureato nella sezione RBP, lavorerai sullo sviluppo, la caratterizzazione e la produzione di materiali target innovativi, sia nel prossimo laboratorio chimico e nano che nel nuovo nano-laboratorio dedicato ai materiali nano-actinide. Contribuirai direttamente a promuovere la produzione di raggi ioni radioattivi, lavorando all'interfaccia di scienza dei materiali, chimica, fisica nucleare e fisica atomica. Le tue responsabilità:
• Sviluppa nuovi materiali di destinazione per la produzione di raggi ioni radioattivi.
• Progettazione, sintesi, processo e ottimizzazione di materiali avanzati con microstrutture e proprietà di estrazione su misura.
• Contribuisci alla messa in servizio del nuovo laboratorio chimico e nano.
• Utilizzare il laboratorio chimico della sezione e le strutture nano-laboratorie per sviluppare e produrre materiali di destinazione innovativi, compresi i sistemi basati su nano-actinide.
• Pianificare e condurre campagne di caratterizzazione dei materiali utilizzando adeguate tecniche di caratterizzazione analitica e strutturale.
• Partecipa attivamente alla qualificazione, al funzionamento, alla prova e alla valutazione dei materiali.
• Analizzare i dati delle prestazioni sperimentali e tradurre i risultati in progetti materiali migliorati e processi produttivi.
• Collabora con team multidisciplinari di fisici, chimici, ingegneri e tecnici del CERN e con partner internazionali.
• Contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche, relazioni tecniche e presentazioni a conferenze e workshop internazionali. Il tuo profilo: Qualificazioni richieste:
• Esperienza nello sviluppo dei materiali, nella sintesi e nella lavorazione.
• Esperienza nelle tecnologie di lavorazione della polvere e tecniche di fabbricazione dei materiali.
• Esperienza con metodi di caratterizzazione materiale e interpretazione dei dati analitici. L'esperienza in una o più delle seguenti aree sarebbe un bene:
• Sviluppo e caratterizzazione di materiali nanodimensionati o porosi.
• Funzionamento e utilizzo di sistemi glovebox.
• Gestione e lavorazione di materiali radioattivi.
• Gestione sicura e lavorazione dei materiali nanometrici.
• Realizzare lo sviluppo e la caratterizzazione dei materiali. Competenze:
• Sviluppo e ingegneria dei materiali.
• Caratterizzazione dei materiali e analisi dei dati.
• Nanomaterials.
• Ricerca sperimentale e soluzione dei problemi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Radioactive Beam Production section (SY-STI-RBP) is seeking a Material Scientist, Materials Engineer, Chemist, or related specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation target materials for radioactive ion beam production at the ISOLDE facility.
As a graduate in the RBP section, you will work on the development, characterisation, and production of innovative target materials, both in the upcoming chemical and nano laboratory and in the newly established nano-laboratory dedicated to nano-actinide materials. You will contribute directly to advancing radioactive ion beam production, working at the interface of materials science, chemistry, nuclear physics, and atomic physics.
Your responsibilities:

• Develop novel target materials for radioactive ion beam production.

• Design, synthesise, process, and optimise advanced materials with tailored microstructures and extraction properties.

• Contribute to the commissioning of the new chemical and nano laboratory.

• Utilise the section's chemical laboratory and nano-laboratory facilities to develop and produce innovative target materials, including nano-actinide-based systems.

• Plan and conduct material characterisation campaigns using appropriate analytical and structural characterisation techniques.

• Actively participate in the qualification, operation, testing, and evaluation of the materials.

• Analyse experimental performance data and translate findings into improved material designs and production processes.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of physicists, chemists, engineers, and technicians within CERN and with international partners.

• Contribute to scientific publications, technical reports, and presentations at international conferences and workshops.
Your profile:
Required Qualifications:

• Experience in materials development, synthesis, and processing.

• Experience in powder processing technologies and material fabrication techniques.

• Experience with material characterisation methods and interpretation of analytical data.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an asset:

• Development and characterisation of nanosized or porous materials.

• Operation and use of glovebox systems.

• Handling and processing of radioactive materials.

• Safe handling and processing of nanometric materials.

• Actinide material development and characterisation.
Skills:

• Materials Development and Engineering.

• Materials Characterisation and Data Analysis.

• Nanomaterials.

• Experimental Research and Problem Solving.

• Laboratory Operations and Commissioning.

• Collaboration in Multidisciplinary Teams.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Materials Science/Engineering, Chemistry (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 27.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-October-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.
Job reference: SY-STI-RBP-2026-166-GRAE
Field of work: Material and Surface Science
Benchmark job: 200080 - Material Science/Chemical Engineer/Chemist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

This project focuses on the conceptual designs and conductor studies for large superconducting detector magnets planned for the Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee) at CERN, the proposed successor to the Large Hadron Collider.
The work involves designing large superconducting solenoids that generate strong magnetic fields to help identify and measure particles produced in electron-positron collisions.
Responsibilities include analytical and finite-element studies of magnet windings, including thermal behavior, cryogenic cooling, and mechanical performance.
The role also includes supporting conductor R&D through studies and prototyping of low- and high-temperature superconductors. Additional tasks involve manufacturing, testing and characterising conductor samples for their superconducting, thermal, electrical, and mechanical properties.
Your responsibilities:

• Conduct conceptual and finite-element studies of superconducting detector magnets, including cold mass geometry, thermal behaviour, cryogenic cooling, and mechanical performance.

• Support the design and optimisation of superconducting magnet systems for future particle detector applications.

• Participate in conductor R&D activities involving both low-temperature and high-temperature superconductors.

• Assist with conductor prototyping, demonstrator manufacturing, and experimental testing campaigns.

• Characterise conductor samples by evaluating their superconducting, thermal, electrical, and mechanical properties.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.
Your profile:

• Background in superconductivity and superconducting technologies.

• Experience with superconducting magnet design and superconductor studies.

• Knowledge of materials science and characterisation techniques.

• Familiarity with experimental physics and cryogenic systems.

• Experience with analytical and finite-element analysis methods.
Skills:

• Finite element analysis skills using commercial software such as Ansys and COMSOL.

• Capability to conduct experimental superconductivity campaigns, including cryogenic handling, operation of superconducting magnets, preparation of experimental setups, and execution of measurement techniques.

• Knowledge of superconducting conductor technologies, including mechanical properties and microstructural/morphological characterisation.

• Effective collaboration in multidisciplinary team environments.

• Independent work and autonomous management of tasks.

• Ability to present and document the outcome of studies

• Ability to supervise students or junior contributors.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Dieses Projekt konzentriert sich auf die konzeptionellen Entwürfe und Leiterstudien für große supraleitende Detektormagnete, die für den Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee) am CERN, dem vorgeschlagenen Nachfolger des Large Hadron Collider, geplant sind. Die Arbeit umfasst die Entwicklung großer supraleitender Magnete, die starke Magnetfelder erzeugen, um Partikel zu identifizieren und zu messen, die bei Elektronen-Positronen-Kollisionen erzeugt werden. Zu den Verantwortlichkeiten gehören analytische und Finite-Elemente-Untersuchungen von Magnetwicklungen, einschließlich des thermischen Verhaltens, der kryogenen Kühlung und der mechanischen Leistung. Die Rolle umfasst auch die Unterstützung der Leiterforschung und -entwicklung durch Studien und das Prototyping von Nieder- und Hochtemperatursupraleitern. Weitere Aufgaben umfassen die Herstellung, Prüfung und Charakterisierung von Leiterproben auf ihre supraleitenden, thermischen, elektrischen und mechanischen Eigenschaften. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Durchführung konzeptioneller und Finite-Elemente-Untersuchungen von supraleitenden Detektormagneten, einschließlich Kaltmassengeometrie, thermischem Verhalten, kryogener Kühlung und mechanischer Leistung.
• Unterstützung des Entwurfs und der Optimierung von supraleitenden Magnetsystemen für zukünftige Partikeldetektoranwendungen.
• Teilnahme an F&E-Aktivitäten für Leiter, die sowohl Nieder- als auch Hochtemperatursupraleiter umfassen.
• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Leiterprototypen, der Herstellung von Demonstratoren und experimentellen Testkampagnen.
• Charakterisierung von Leiterproben durch Bewertung ihrer supraleitenden, thermischen, elektrischen und mechanischen Eigenschaften.
• Diese Rolle umfasst die Verantwortung der Teamaufsicht. Ihr Profil:
• Hintergrund in Supraleitfähigkeit und supraleitenden Technologien.
• Erfahrung mit supraleitendem Magnetdesign und Supraleiterstudien.
• Kenntnisse der Materialwissenschaften und Charakterisierungstechniken.
• Vertrautheit mit experimenteller Physik und kryogenen Systemen.
• Erfahrung mit analytischen und Finite-Elemente-Analysemethoden. Fähigkeiten:
• Finite-Elemente-Analysefähigkeiten mit kommerzieller Software wie Ansys und COMSOL.
• Fähigkeit, experimentelle Supraleitungskampagnen durchzuführen, einschließlich kryogener Handhabung, Betrieb von supraleitenden Magneten, Vorbereitung von Versuchsanordnungen und Ausführung von Messtechniken.
• Kenntnisse über supraleitende Leitertechnologien, einschließlich mechanischer Eigenschaften und mikrostruktureller/morphologischer Charakterisierung.
• Effektive Zusammenarbeit in multidisziplinären Teamumgebungen.

Ce projet met l'accent sur les conceptions conceptuelles et les études de conducteurs de gros aimants de détecteur supraconducteurs prévus pour le futur collisionneur circulaire (FCC-ee) au CERN, le successeur proposé du grand collisionneur à hadron. Le travail consiste à concevoir de grands solénoïdes supraconducteurs qui génèrent des champs magnétiques puissants pour aider à identifier et mesurer les particules produites dans les collisions électro-positrons. Les responsabilités comprennent des études analytiques et à éléments finis des enroulements magnétiques, y compris le comportement thermique, le refroidissement cryogénique et les performances mécaniques. Le rôle consiste également à appuyer la R-D des conducteurs par des études et des prototypages de supraconducteurs à basse et haute température. D'autres tâches comprennent la fabrication, l'essai et la caractérisation d'échantillons de conducteurs pour leurs propriétés supraconductrices, thermiques, électriques et mécaniques. Vos responsabilités :
• Effectuer des études conceptuelles et à éléments finis des aimants de détecteur supraconducteurs, y compris la géométrie de la masse froide, le comportement thermique, le refroidissement cryogénique et les performances mécaniques.
• Soutenir la conception et l'optimisation de systèmes d'aimants supraconducteurs pour les applications futures de détecteurs de particules.
• Participer aux activités de R-D des conducteurs comportant des supraconducteurs à basse température et à haute température.
• Aider au prototypage des conducteurs, à la fabrication des démonstrateurs et aux campagnes expérimentales d'essais.
• Caractériser les échantillons de conducteurs en évaluant leurs propriétés supraconductrices, thermiques, électriques et mécaniques.
• Ce rôle comprend les responsabilités de supervision de l'équipe. Votre profil:
• Contexte de la supraconductivité et des technologies supraconductrices.
• Expérience de la conception d'aimants supraconducteurs et études de supraconducteurs.
• Connaissance des sciences des matériaux et des techniques de caractérisation.
• Connaissance de la physique expérimentale et des systèmes cryogéniques.
• Expérience des méthodes d'analyse et d'analyse des éléments finis. Compétences :
• Compétences en analyse d'éléments finis à l'aide de logiciels commerciaux comme Ansys et COMSOL.
• Capacité de mener des campagnes expérimentales de supraconductivité, y compris la manipulation cryogénique, le fonctionnement des aimants supraconducteurs, la préparation des configurations expérimentales et l'exécution des techniques de mesure.
• Connaissance des technologies des conducteurs supraconducteurs, y compris les propriétés mécaniques et la caractérisation microstructurale/morphologique.
• Collaboration efficace dans des environnements d'équipe multidisciplinaires.
• Travail indépendant et gestion autonome des tâches.
• Capacité de présenter et de documenter les résultats des études
• Capacité de superviser les étudiants ou les contributeurs juniors.
• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français. Critères d'éligibilité:
• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .
• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en physique appliquée (ou dans un domaine connexe) et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;
• ou d'un doctorat d'une durée maximale de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.
• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures. Date de clôture de l'emploi: 23.07.2026 à 23:59 CEST. RADNEXT 2030 è un progetto Horizon Europe Research Infrastructure Services che offre un accesso coordinato transnazionale alle strutture di test sugli effetti delle radiazioni in tutta Europa e oltre. CERN è il coordinatore del progetto e gestisce anche due strutture chiave all'interno della rete: CHARM e HEARTS@CERN . Questa posizione è incorporata nell'attività Radiation to Electronics (R2E) all'interno del reparto Sistemi Acceleratori. Potrai lavorare all'interfaccia tra la gestione del progetto, le operazioni di accesso all'utente e la ricerca sugli effetti delle radiazioni, contribuendo alla riuscita consegna degli obiettivi di RADNEXT 2030. Si otterrà un'ampia esposizione alla comunità europea di assicurazione della durezza radiazioni, all'infrastruttura dell'acceleratore del CERN, e alla progettazione, esecuzione e analisi degli esperimenti sugli effetti delle radiazioni. Le tue responsabilità:
• I lavori sulla definizione e il coordinamento del flusso di lavoro di accesso transnazionale per le strutture nell'ambito di RADNEXT 2030.
• Contribuisci alla definizione, ai test e al miglioramento del portale di accesso online della struttura.
• Fornire supporto scientifico all'organizzazione e alla consegna delle attività di consorzio RADNEXT 2030.
• Sostenere le attività di comunicazione scientifica, diffusione e divulgazione di RADNEXT 2030.
• Contribuire a compiti di ricerca applicati, con un focus sulle nuove tecniche del fascio e sulla caratterizzazione dell'ambiente di radiazione, in particolare i fasci di pesante frammentati per i test full LET-spectrum e gli studi di proxy di impulso-elettronico SEE.
• Sostenere l'integrazione della struttura HEARTS@CERN e la relativa gestione degli utenti nel consorzio RADNEXT 2030.
• Impegnarsi con la più ampia comunità di effetti radiazioni attraverso la base utente RADNEXT 2030, sostenendo attività di formazione, tra cui la Radiation Effects Testing Summer School. Il tuo profilo:
• Esperienza negli effetti delle radiazioni verifica e resistenza alla durezza delle radiazioni.
• Esperienza nella progettazione, preparazione ed esecuzione di esperimenti di irradiazione.
• Esperienza nella scrittura scientifica e diffusione (pubblicazioni, relazioni, contributi congressuali).
• La familiarità con il coordinamento del progetto, il supporto degli utenti o le attività di servizio scientifico sarebbe un vantaggio. Competenze:
• Conoscenza degli effetti delle radiazioni nell'elettronica e dei principali standard e metodologie di prova delle radiazioni (ad esempio ESA/ECSS, MIL-STD).
• Conoscenza delle strutture dell'acceleratore di particelle e della fisica dell'interazione della materia radioattiva relativa ai test sugli effetti delle radiazioni.
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di progetto multi-istituzionale internazionale e di interagire con una comunità di utenti diversificata.
• Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione, con capacità di gestire più compiti e scadenze.

• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;
• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
RADNEXT 2030  is a Horizon Europe Research Infrastructure Services project that provides coordinated transnational access to radiation effects testing facilities across Europe and beyond. CERN is the project coordinator and also operates two key facilities within the network: CHARM and HEARTS@CERN .
This position is embedded in the Radiation to Electronics (R2E) activity within the Accelerator Systems department. You will work at the interface between project management, user access operations, and radiation effects research, contributing to the successful delivery of RADNEXT 2030's objectives.
You will gain broad exposure to the European radiation hardness assurance community, to CERN's accelerator infrastructure, and to the design, execution and analysis of radiation effects experiments.
Your responsibilities:

• Work on the definition and coordination of the transnational access workflow for facilities within the RADNEXT 2030 framework.

• Contribute to the definition, testing and improvement of the facility access online portal.

• Provide scientific support to the organisation and delivery of RADNEXT 2030 consortium activities.

• Support the scientific communication, dissemination and outreach activities of RADNEXT 2030.

• Contribute to applied research tasks, with a focus on novel beam techniques and radiation environment characterisation, in particular fragmented heavy-ion beams for full LET-spectrum testing and pulsed-electron SEE proxy studies.

• Support the integration of the HEARTS@CERN facility and its related user management into the RADNEXT 2030 consortium.

• Engage with the broader radiation effects community through the RADNEXT 2030 user base, supporting training activities including the Radiation Effects Testing Summer School.
Your profile:

• Experience in radiation effects testing and radiation hardness assurance.

• Experience in the design, preparation and execution of irradiation experiments.

• Experience in scientific writing and dissemination (publications, reports, conference contributions).

• Familiarity with project coordination, user support or scientific service activities would be an advantage.
Skills:

• Knowledge of radiation effects in electronics and of the main radiation test standards and methodologies (e.g. ESA/ECSS, MIL-STD).

• Knowledge of particle accelerator facilities and radiation-matter interaction physics relevant to radiation effects testing.

• Ability to work in an international, multi-institutional project environment and to interact with a diverse user community.

• Strong organisational and communication skills, with ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Electronics Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's Degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 22.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: SY-STI-BMP-2026-118-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an applied physicist, you will contribute to the development of radiation-hard Spaghetti Calorimeter (SpaCal) technology with dense absorbers to achieve picosecond-level time resolutions. This work is part of the strategic detector R&D programme within the Experimental Physics (EP) Department at CERN.
Your responsibilities

• Actively participate in ongoing R&D efforts to develop and optimise Spaghetti Calorimeter (SpaCal) technology for the LHCb PicoCal and other applications.

• Take part in the test-beam and laboratory characterisation of SpaCal prototype modules, with the aim of optimising the time resolution.

• Contribute to studies aimed at optimising photon detectors for SpaCal technology.

• Characterise novel radiation-hard, fast crystal scintillating fibres and organic scintillating materials.

• Document the results in scientific publications.
More information here .
Your profile

• Proven track record in the development of detectors for particle physics experiments.

• Demonstrated experience in calorimeter detector testing, both in the laboratory and in test-beam environments.

• Experience in the characterisation of photon detectors and/or scintillators is an advantage.

• Experience in the simulation of optical calorimeter technologies is an advantage.
Skills

• Understanding of optical calorimeter concepts.

• Practical knowledge of laboratory equipment and data acquisition systems.

• Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary team with physicists, engineers and technicians.

• Knowledge of programming languages such as C++ and Python.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 22.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-November-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to lead.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: EP-LCB-2026-126-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.en:
The goal of this project is to introduce innovative selections into the ATLAS trigger system to improve the identification of events in difficult regions of the parameter space, including rare Standard Model processes and exotic signatures. In collaboration with NextGen doctoral students, the selected candidate will contribute to the development of the trigger menu for the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) era. The position is part of the Next Generation Trigger programme.
Your responsibilities

• Design new triggering algorithms and strategies, including alternative data flows and ML/AI-based approaches.

• Develop tools to support HL-LHC trigger menu studies.

• Simulate trigger selections and estimate trigger rates using data and HL-LHC Monte Carlo samples.

• Ensure that proposed solutions meet trigger menu constraints on processing resources and rate limits.

• Implement solutions within the central ATLAS trigger software.

• Collaborate closely with ATLAS trigger and TDAQ upgrade experts.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.
Your profile

• Strong background in collider physics.

• Experience with AI/ML and trigger systems.
Skills

• Strong software skills

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Experience with, or willingness to supervise, students.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You have a professional background in PhD in Physics or a related field, and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 22.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-October-2026
This position involves:

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: EP-ATL-OSW-2026-124-GRAP
Field of work: Experimental Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione: Sei appassionato di abilitare la scienza aperta attraverso servizi informatici avanzati, infrastrutture di dati e ambienti di ricerca collaborativi? Ti piace combinare lavoro tecnico pratico con impegno in diverse comunità scientifiche? Partecipa al Dipartimento IT del CERN e contribuisce allo sviluppo di servizi di elaborazione scientifica che supportano le strutture di analisi, i dati aperti e le infrastrutture di ricerca interoperabili. Il Gruppo Applicazioni Collaborative (IT-CA) fornisce piattaforme e servizi che consentono la collaborazione, la condivisione delle conoscenze e la gestione delle informazioni scientifiche in CERN e nelle sue comunità. All'interno di IT-CA, la sezione Repositori Istituzionali (IT-CA-IR) sviluppa e gestisce servizi per dati di ricerca, pubblicazioni, scienze aperte e conoscenze istituzionali. La sezione sta inoltre costruendo e coordinando il Nodo CERN EOSC, il contributo del CERN all’ecosistema europeo Open Science Cloud. Funzioni:
• Contribuisci alla progettazione tecnica, allo sviluppo e al funzionamento di strutture di analisi che supportano flussi di lavoro di analisi scientifica scalabili e riproducibili.
• Progettare e implementare Virtual Research Environments (VREs) combinando gestione dei dati, esecuzione del flusso di lavoro, distribuzione software e servizi di analisi.
• Contribuisci alle infrastrutture di dati scientifiche federate, inclusi i concetti di data lake, la gestione dei dati distribuiti e l'accesso ai dati su larga scala.
• Sostenere e coordinare le attività tecniche con le comunità scientifiche coinvolte nelle sfide dei dati scientifici aperti, tra cui la fisica delle particelle e le infrastrutture di ricerca esterne, e contribuire al ruolo di coordinamento tecnico nella collaborazione di ESCAPE.
• Sviluppare e mantenere componenti software, integrazioni di servizi e strumenti operativi per i servizi di elaborazione scientifica, tra cui implementazioni e automazione cloud-native.
• Promuovere soluzioni comuni e migliori pratiche nelle comunità, contribuendo a centri di competenza, gruppi di lavoro e forum tecnici collaborativi.
• Lavorare con infrastrutture di ricerca e domini scientifici come la fisica delle particelle, l'astronomia, la fisica astroparticolare, tra gli altri per tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni di calcolo robuste.
• Master's Degree o PhD o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo di Software Engineering, Fisica o un campo relativo. Esperienza:
• Sviluppo e funzionamento di piattaforme di calcolo scientifico o servizi di ricerca.
• Impianti di analisi, ambienti di analisi distribuiti o flussi di lavoro scientifici interattivi.
• Gestione dei dati su larga scala, architetture del lago di dati o infrastrutture federate.
• Integrazione di servizi di dati di ricerca, repository, piattaforme di workflow o sistemi di autenticazione e autorizzazione.
• Collaborazione tecnica con comunità scientifiche o infrastrutture di ricerca internazionali.
• La familiarità con la scienza aperta, i principi di dati FAIR, i repository di ricerca o i servizi correlati a EOSC sarebbe un vantaggio.
• L'esperienza in un ruolo di coordinamento nelle comunità scientifiche distribuite intorno all'analisi dei dati e alla gestione dei dati sarebbe un bene.
• Esperienza con strumenti come Rucio, REANA, CVMFS, tecnologia Notebook (ad esempio JupyterLab), o Zenodo/InvenioRDM sarebbe un bene. Competenze tecniche:
• Conoscenza delle tecniche di programmazione e linguaggi: per i servizi di calcolo scientifico, in particolare in Python, con familiarità nelle tecnologie web come JavaScript e React.
• Architettura e progettazione di sistemi ICT: progettazione, distribuzione e funzionamento di sistemi distribuiti e applicazioni cloud-native.
• Conoscenza dei sistemi operativi: conoscenza delle tecnologie di containerizzazione e orchestrazione come Kubernetes e Helm.
• Informatica, gestione dei dati e accesso ai dati federati.
• Esperienza con piattaforme di analisi, sistemi di flusso di lavoro o ambienti di ricerca virtuali. Competenze comportamentali:
