Sind Sie ein praktischer Physiker mit einem starken Interesse an fortschrittlichen Detektortechnologien und Softwareentwicklung? Schließen Sie sich der Abteilung für Experimentelle Physik (EP) des CERN an und tragen Sie zur nächsten Generation von Instrumenten für das ATLAS-Experiment am LHC mit hoher Luminosität bei. Sie arbeiten eng mit internationalen Teams zusammen, die zum LUminosity Cherenkov Integrating Detector (LUCID-3) und zum High-Luminosity Zero Degree Calorimeter (HL-ZDC) beitragen. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, an der Spitze der experimentellen Teilchenphysik zu arbeiten und Hardware-, Firmware- und Softwareentwicklung in einem hochgradig kooperativen und internationalen Umfeld zu kombinieren. Ihre Verantwortung
• Beitrag zum Testen und Validieren von Komponenten für das ATLAS Forward Detector Upgrade.
• Entwicklung und Wartung von Software für die Datenerfassungselektronik.
• Design und Unterstützung von Online-Monitoring-Tools.
• Eine aktive Rolle bei den Laboraktivitäten am CERN spielen, einschließlich der Prüfung einzelner Elektronikkomponenten und der Validierung der vollständigen Detektorauslesekette innerhalb der Forward Detectors-Labors. Dein Profil
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Datenerfassungssystemen in hochenergetischen Physikexperimenten, einschließlich Detektorauslesung und Integration.
• Die Vertrautheit mit Firmware (z. B. FPGA-basierte Systeme) und Hardware-Software-Integration ist sehr wünschenswert.
• Erfahrung mit Online-Überwachungssystemen und Echtzeit-Datenqualitätsbewertung ist eine Bereicherung.
• Das Verständnis von Triggersystemen (insbesondere Level-1) und Detektorsteuerungs-/Betriebskonzepten ist vorteilhaft.
• Praktische Erfahrung in der Laborarbeit, einschließlich Prüfung und Validierung von Elektronikkomponenten und Ausleseketten. Fähigkeiten
• Starke Programmierkenntnisse in C++ und Python mit solider Erfahrung in UNIX/Linux-Umgebungen.
• Erfahrung mit ROOT-basiertem Datenhandling, Analyse und Visualisierung.
• Demonstrierte Problemlösungsfähigkeit und eine proaktive "Can-do" -Haltung mit der Bereitschaft, zum Detektorbetrieb und zu Bereitschaftsaktivitäten beizutragen.
• Strenge und gut organisierte Herangehensweise an die Arbeit, mit Liebe zum Detail und der Fähigkeit, qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern.
• Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch in einer internationalen, kollaborativen Teamumgebung effektiv zu arbeiten.
• Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen. Förderkriterien:
• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitglieds oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats.
• Sie haben einen beruflichen Hintergrund in Physik oder verwandten (oder einem verwandten Bereich) und haben entweder:
• einen Master-Abschluss mit 2 bis 6 Jahren Berufserfahrung nach dem Abschluss;
• oder einen Doktortitel mit nicht mehr als 3 Jahren Berufserfahrung nach dem Abschluss.
• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag. Arbeitsabschluss: 16.07.2026 um 23:59 Uhr MESZ. Vertragsdauer: 24 Monate, mit einer möglichen Verlängerung auf maximal 36 Monate. Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort Startdatum: 01-Oktober-2026 Diese Position umfasst:
• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.
• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.
• Exposition gegenüber dem Risiko eines Sturzes aus der Höhe während der Gerüstmontage und Demontage. Angesichts der mit dieser Position verbundenen beruflichen Gesundheitsrisiken muss der ausgewählte Kandidat eine ärztliche Genehmigung einholen, bevor ein Vertragsangebot bestätigt wird. Arbeitsnummer: EP-ATL-AM-2026-119-GRAP Arbeitsgebiet: Angewandte Physik Benchmark-Job: 200140 - Angewandter Physiker Globale Vorteile

Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous un physicien pratique qui s'intéresse beaucoup aux technologies de détection avancées et au développement de logiciels? Rejoignez le département de Physique Expérimentale (EP) du CERN et contribuez à la prochaine génération d'instrumentation pour l'expérience ATLAS au LHC de Haute Luminosité. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internationales qui contribuent au détecteur d'intégration de Cherenkov de Luminosity (LUCID-3) et au calorimètre à haut degré de Luminosity Zero (HL-ZDC). Cette position offre une occasion unique de travailler à l'avant-garde de la physique expérimentale des particules, combinant matériel, firmware et développement logiciel dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et international. Vos responsabilités
• Contribuer à l'essai et à la validation des composants pour la mise à niveau du détecteur avant ATLAS.
• Développement et maintenance de logiciels pour l'acquisition de données électroniques.
• Conception et soutien d'outils de surveillance en ligne.
• Jouer un rôle actif dans les activités en laboratoire au CERN, y compris l'essai de composants électroniques individuels et la validation de la chaîne complète de lecture des détecteurs au sein des laboratoires Forward Detectors. Votre profil
• Expérience éprouvée des systèmes d'acquisition de données dans les expériences de physique à haute énergie, y compris la lecture et l'intégration des détecteurs.
• La connaissance du firmware (par exemple les systèmes FPGA) et de l'intégration matériel-logiciel est hautement souhaitable.
• L'expérience des systèmes de surveillance en ligne et de l'évaluation de la qualité des données en temps réel est un atout.
• La compréhension des systèmes de déclenchement (en particulier le niveau 1) et des concepts de contrôle/exploitation des détecteurs est avantageuse.
• Expérience pratique en laboratoire, y compris l'essai et la validation des composants électroniques et des chaînes de lecture. Compétences
• Des compétences de programmation solides en C++ et Python, avec une solide expérience dans les environnements UNIX/Linux.
• Expérience de la manipulation, de l'analyse et de la visualisation des données basées sur ROOT.
• Capacité démontrée de résolution de problèmes et attitude proactive, « possible », avec la volonté de contribuer au fonctionnement du détecteur et aux activités sur appel.
• Approche rigoureuse et bien organisée du travail, avec une attention aux détails et la capacité de produire des résultats de haute qualité.
• Capacité de travailler efficacement, de façon indépendante et dans un environnement d'équipes internationales et collaboratives.
• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français. Critères d'éligibilité:
• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .
• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en physique ou dans un domaine connexe et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;
• ou d'un doctorat d'une durée maximale de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.
• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures. Date de clôture de l'emploi: 16.07.2026 à 23:59 CEST. Durée du contrat : 24 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation jusqu'à 36 mois maximum. Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place Date de début prévue : 01 octobre 2026 Cette position implique:
• Travail dans les zones de rayonnement.
• Interventions dans des installations souterraines.
• Exposition au risque de chute des hauteurs lors des opérations de montage et de démontage des échafaudages. Compte tenu des risques pour la santé au travail associés à ce poste, le candidat sélectionné doit obtenir une attestation médicale avant de confirmer une offre de contrat. Référence de l'emploi: EP-ATL-AM-2026-119-GRAP Domaine de travail: Physique appliquée Travail de référence : 200140 - Médecin appliqué Avantages globaux
• Une allocation mensuelle entre 6372-004 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.
• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.
• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.
• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.
• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.
• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.
• Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues. Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible ! Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent. Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu. Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît ! Plus d'informations sur nous, ici: carriers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
You will join our multicultural team of around 20 Talent Acquisition colleagues to attract and hire diverse talent for CERN’s scientific and technical missions. Each team member partners with specific client groups, and brings their knowledge, ideas and diverse strengths to the team.

Together we have some ambitious goals, such as increasing the representation of women in STEM and strengthening nationality diversity in all types of hires, from students to seasoned professionals. You will be expected to handle big volumes of recruitment, and contribute to the shaping of first-class recruitment experiences for all stakeholders.
Functions

• Partner with hiring teams and stakeholder groups to deliver on their recruitment needs. This includes translating their needs in market-ready job ads and attraction strategies; facilitating fair, transparent and inclusive selection processes.

• Deliver a seamless, welcoming and inclusive candidate experience from first contact through to offer and onboarding.

• Build and engage relevant talent communities.

• Contribute to the overall employer branding strategies and its translation into practice with proposals, engaging with the public through social media and representing CERN at events.

• Support the shaping of our future recruitment processes in particular for students and grads by staying informed and curious, translating findings in a creative and/or open-minded collaboration.

• Use internal and external data as appropriate for decision making and reporting.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.

Experience
Experience in :

• End-to-end recruitment within an in-house team, ideally in an international environment.

• Sourcing and engaging talent across different roles; Employer Branding, Social Media and Outreach initiatives.

• HR data and analytics to drive and support informed decision-making is considered as an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Talent Acquisition: mastery of talent acquisition processes and best practices.

• Customer service: strong ability to provide excellent service to internal and external stakeholders.

• Direct sourcing: proficiency in proactive sourcing techniques and tools to proactively identify and engage potential candidates.

• Information content publishing: knowledge and use of applicant tracking systems and other web-based applications.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Working in Teams: contributing to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addressing issues.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Demonstrating Accountability: using openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 15.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (3 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
Job grade: 4-5
Job reference: HR-TA-2026-130-LD
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark Job Title: Human Resources Support Officer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

Join our Human Resources People eXperience and Engagement team of HR Coordinators and HR Advisors to play a key role in shaping the employee journey at CERN, supporting a diverse community of students, graduates, and staff while navigating a dynamic and evolving environment, by designing and delivering tailored HR support, services, and policies. If you have an eye for detail and a genuine interest in people and HR matters, are keen to gain a deep understanding of HR processes, and develop your interpersonal skills, then this is the right position for you.
Your responsibilities:

• Ensure efficient, friendly, and reliable administration and communication for various HR processes and queries, supporting HR professionals and their client departments.

• Inform and advise student and graduate populations throughout their experience at CERN on several topics (regulations, integration, processes, etc.).

• Deliver engaging presentations on HR topics to a variety of audiences, both within and beyond the group.

• Master the swift administration of contractual actions for several populations.
Your profile:

• Experience dealing with discretion and confidentiality.

• Interest/experience with delivering presentations.

• Interest/experience with customer service roles.
Skills:

• Effective written and oral communication, adapting the style to different audiences.

• Working in teams, promoting a positive atmosphere through an optimistic and constructive attitude.

• Maintaning discretion and accountability.

• Delivering high-quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Proactive attitude on taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• MS Office knowledge.

• Presentation crafting and delivering skills.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Human Resources, Administration, related (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 19.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-September-2026
Job reference: HR-PXE-2026-174-GRAE
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark job: 5B0130 - Human Resources Support Officer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Questo aggiunge una dimensione aggiuntiva alle informazioni disponibili ed è essenziale per mitigare gli effetti di accumulazione ad alta luminosità. Il progetto CASSIA (CMOS Active SenSor with Internal Amplification) mira a sviluppare sensori di pixel attivi monolitici (MAPS) con guadagno di segnale interno e basso rumore in un processo di imaging CMOS ampiamente utilizzato, mirando a una vasta gamma di applicazioni. descriptionByLocale.en:
Dense tracking environments in experiments at CERN's High-Luminosity LHC and future FCC experiments require increased use of timing information in addition to the position measurements provided by pixel detectors. This adds an extra dimension to the available information and is essential for mitigating pile-up effects at high luminosities. The CASSIA Project (CMOS Active SenSor with Internal Amplification) aims to develop monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) with internal signal gain and low noise in a widely used CMOS imaging process, targeting a broad range of applications.
Your responsibilities

• Assemble and test CASSIA sensor prototypes on PCBs.

• Support and improve signal measurements in laboratory measurements, irradiations and test beams.

• Analyse CASSIA2 for optimal signal collection and time resolution.

• Investigate radiation hardness and the change of gain as a function of irradiation.

• Test CASSIA2 on chip amplifier circuits against circuit simulation, characterise the front-end (FE) circuit performance for time resolution and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

• Improve the design of CASSIA2 circuits for optimal time resolution in LGAD and SPAD mode.

• Develop concepts for integration of CASSIA pixel designs into asynchronous readout pixel circuits in matrices (CASSIA3 studies).

• Circuit design and implementation, design verification, pre-/post-layout simulations for optimised pixel designs and FE-circuits for large matrices.

• Collaborate closely with engineers, physicists, and technicians in a multidisciplinary team.
Your profile

• Experience with the assembly, testing, and characterisation of silicon detector modules or similar systems.

• Practical experience with laboratory instrumentation such as probe stations, laser test setups, beam test setups.

• Ability to design PCBs for ASICs/sensors as part of the test system.

• Ability to perform electronic measurements to characterise analogue and digital on-chip circuits.

• Experience in automating laboratory procedures and data acquisition.

• Experience with tools used for the design, integration and verification of ASICs/CMOS sensors.

• Familiarity with data analysis, circuit simulation and electronics debugging.

• Experience working in large, international research collaborations and contributing to common infrastructure or shared facilities.

• Demonstrated ability to plan, prioritise and deliver results under tight schedules.
Skills

• Knowledge of monolithic CMOS sensors, MAPS, silicon pixel detectors for high energy physics experiments.

• Experience in testing silicon sensors and required laboratory equipment.

• Experience in circuit simulation and characterisation.

• Working experience in ASIC and/or CMOS sensor design and using industry tools for design, implementation, and verification.

• Organised, accurate and independent approach to work.

• Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and international collaborations.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Electronics or Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 15.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-117-GRAP
Field of work: Experimental Physics
Benchmark job: 200050 - Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Das CASSIA-Projekt (CMOS Active SenSor with Internal Amplification) zielt darauf ab, monolithische aktive Pixelsensoren (MAPS) mit interner Signalverstärkung und geringem Rauschen in einem weit verbreiteten CMOS-Bildgebungsverfahren zu entwickeln, das auf eine breite Palette von Anwendungen abzielt. descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Project Engineer within the SCE Department (Project Portfolio Management Group), you will contribute to the delivery of complex construction projects at CERN. Reporting to a CERN Project Manager, you will coordinate interfaces with internal and external stakeholders throughout the design and construction phases, ensuring smooth collaboration while meeting technical, scheduling, budgetary, and safety objectives.
Your responsibilities:

• Participate in feasibility studies and preliminary design of new projects, including the coordination of civil engineering design services with external design offices (architects/engineers) and other equipment/services (MEP building services and accelerator equipment), leading to the submission of detailed designs to CERN users.

• Participate in the preparation of invitations to tender, selection of firms, opening of offers and decisions related to designer or contractor selection.

• Supervise the execution of civil engineering works on-site, ensuring compliance with contractual design drawings and specification documents in liaison with external consultants (architects/engineers), while monitoring measurements, payments, costs and schedules.

• Organise hand-over procedures for civil works, follow up any subsequent work required to ensure compliance with specifications, and ensure that all safety measures are implemented on-site to keep the accident rate to a minimum.
Your profile:

• Interest in construction projects and project coordination, with a willingness to learn under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Organised, proactive, flexible and able to work autonomously in a multi-tasking environment.

• Good communication and team spirit in an international environment, with an open-minded and diplomatic approach.
Skills:

• Good knowledge of project management tools, including proficiency in the MS Office suite and MS Project.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Civil Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 15.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-January-2027
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: SCE-PPM-PM-2026-110-GRAP
Field of work: Civil Engineering
Benchmark job: 200010 - Civil Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

Introduzione In qualità di tecnico elettromeccanico versatile con esperienza nell'installazione e nel mantenimento di un'ampia gamma di attrezzature, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'aggiornamento delle infrastrutture e nell'implementazione del progetto di aggiornamento ATLAS (2026–2030). Nell'ambito del team di coordinamento tecnico ATLAS, vi legherete con i team di rivelatori, contribuite alla decommissione delle apparecchiature esistenti e parteciperete all'installazione e alla messa in servizio della nuova infrastruttura rack, supportando i team di rivelatori nel loro lavoro di installazione. Funzioni
• Partecipare alla decommissione di rack elettronici esistenti.
• Contribuisci all'installazione di nuovi rack nelle caverne dei servizi sotterranei, compresi i sistemi di raffreddamento e distribuzione del rack e le turbine di ventilazione, per soddisfare le future esigenze dei sistemi di rivelatore ATLAS.
• Partecipare alla messa in servizio dei rack ed essere responsabile della manutenzione dei sistemi di raffreddamento e distribuzione di energia rack, compresa la gestione dei pezzi di ricambio.
• Contribuire al montaggio, installazione e manutenzione di turbine di ventilazione rack.
• Supporta l'aggiornamento e la manutenzione dell'hardware Detector Safety System (DSS).
• Partecipa al routing dei cavi e all'installazione di apparecchiature elettromeccaniche per l'infrastruttura dei rivelatori ATLAS.
• Supporta la manutenzione di dispositivi di controllo e monitoraggio ambientali comuni (ad esempio, webcam, temperatura e sensori di umidità, ecc.).
• Sostenere il funzionamento, la manutenzione e la ristrutturazione delle strutture di superficie ATLAS.
• Coordinate, in collaborazione con il gruppo responsabile di Access & Alarms, la manutenzione del sistema sniffer utilizzato per monitorare la concentrazione di fumo o gas infiammabile.
• Fai parte del team di chiamata Detector Safety System (DSS). Diploma tecnico superiore o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'elettromeccanica o di un campo correlato. Esperienza:
• Esperienza dimostrata nella manutenzione e nel montaggio di sistemi elettromeccanici.

• La conoscenza dei sistemi di ventilazione e sniffer è un vantaggio.
• Competenza nel lavoro su vari progetti in parallelo.
• L'esperienza nella pianificazione e nel coordinamento dei lavori di manutenzione è un vantaggio. Competenze tecniche:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
As a versatile electromechanical technician with experience in installing and maintaining a wide range of equipment, you will play a key role in the infrastructure upgrade and implementation of the ATLAS upgrade project (2026–2030). As part of the ATLAS Technical Coordination team, you will liaise with detector teams, contribute to the decommissioning of existing equipment, and participate in the installation and commissioning of the new rack infrastructure, while supporting detector teams in their installation work.

Functions

• Participate in the decommissioning of existing electronics racks.

• Contribute to the installation of new racks in the underground service caverns, including rack cooling and power distribution systems as well as ventilation turbines, to meet the future needs of the ATLAS detector systems.

• Participate in the commissioning of the racks and be responsible for the maintenance of rack cooling and  power distribution systems, including spare parts management.

• Contribute to the assembly, installation, and maintenance of rack ventilation turbines.

• Support the upgrade and maintenance of the PLC-based Detector Safety System (DSS) hardware.

• Participate in cable routing and in the installation of electromechanical equipment for ATLAS detector infrastructure.

• Support the maintenance of common environmental control and monitoring devices (e.g., webcams, temperature, and humidity sensors, etc.).

• Support the operation, maintenance and refurbishment of the ATLAS surface facilities.

• Coordinate, in collaboration with the group responsible for Access & Alarms, the maintenance of the sniffer system used to monitor the concentration of smoke or flammable gas.

• Be part of the Detector Safety System (DSS) on-call team.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electromechanics or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in the maintenance and assembly of electromechanical systems.

• Proven knowledge of electrical distribution, cabling, sensors and water cooling is required.

• Knowledge of ventilation and sniffer systems is an advantage.

• Proficiency in working on various projects in parallel.

• Experience in scheduling and coordinating maintenance work is an advantage.
Technical competencies:

• Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Electromechanical testing.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily accepting new tasks or work/projects.

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: EP-ATL-SO-2026-129-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Electromechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione: Il Dipartimento di Ingegneria (EN) spinge avanti i limiti della tecnologia in modo che i fisici possono svolgere la loro ricerca. All'interno del reparto EN, il gruppo Mechanical and Materials Engineering (MME) fornisce alla comunità CERN soluzioni ingegneristiche specifiche che combinano design meccanico, fabbricazione e scienze materiali. Sei appassionato di meccanica, e sei abile nel design computer-aided? E' un'opportunita' per te. Sarete parte di un team di progetto multidisciplinare che progetta, realizza e testa una nuova generazione di componenti per il Future Circular Collider (FCC). In qualità di ingegnere tecnico meccanico presso l'ufficio di progettazione MME (EN-MME-MD), sarai responsabile dell'ingegneria meccanica e della progettazione di nuove attrezzature complesse e sistemi meccanici per progetti di fisica ad alta energia e nuovi acceleratori e in particolare per le apparecchiature Superconducting Radio Frequency (SRF) per la FCC. Studi strutturali e termomeccanici, progettazione di attrezzature a pressione, criogenia, tecnologia a vuoto ultra-alto, progettazione sostenibile e produzione, sicurezza, affidabilità, gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto sono solo alcune delle parole chiave relative a questa posizione. Funzioni:
• Gestione tecnica delle attività di ufficio di progettazione in collaborazione con altri servizi all'interno del gruppo EN-MME e con esperti e stakeholder CERN ampia, in particolare per l'accelerazione delle cavità nell'ambito del progetto FCC.
• Analisi dei requisiti di progettazione basati su specifiche funzionali o altre informazioni rilevanti.
• Esecuzione di studi di progettazione di assemblaggi meccanici, componenti, utensili, integrazione attrezzature e layout.
• Creazione di modelli 3D dettagliati e disegni tecnici (comprese le specifiche, i dettagli, la fabbricazione, l'assemblaggio, l'installazione, i disegni as-costruiti e di verifica), in consultazione con gli esperti di produzione e materiali del CERN e nel rispetto dei relativi standard di progettazione e redazione.
• Preparazione della documentazione del progetto secondo le procedure di garanzia della qualità del Design Office.
• Preparazione di presentazioni, relazioni tecniche, specifiche tecniche e note di calcolo.
• Preparazione delle specifiche tecniche e partecipazione ai negoziati contrattuali.
• Seguito, in stretta interazione con altri team e servizi, della produzione, montaggio e installazione di componenti meccanici.
• Fornire la supervisione tecnica e la guida a un team di designer e disegnatori per garantire qualità, coerenza e conformità ai requisiti.
• Assicurare il follow-up di attività assegnate utilizzando strumenti amministrativi interni, tra cui la preparazione di stime, il mantenimento di descrizioni dei posti di lavoro, e il trattamento di modifiche per sostenere la fatturazione tempestiva e accurata.
• Corso di laurea o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato. Esperienza:
• Provata esperienza come designer in un ufficio di progettazione meccanica, eseguendo dimensionamento meccanico e utilizzando strumenti di analisi meccanica standard (analitica e numerica).
• Esperienza comprovata con design orientato al computer.
• Esperienza nella produzione di disegni tecnici di componenti e sistemi meccanici, idealmente secondo gli standard ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS) per il disegno di dimensionamento e tolerancing.
• L'esperienza con la suite software CATIA computer-aided-design sarebbe un bene. Competenze tecniche:
• Progettazione e costruzione di macchine: capacità di analizzare e risolvere problemi di ingegneria meccanica utilizzando la forza dei principi di selezione di materiali e materiali.
• Progettazione e analisi delle strutture meccaniche: con la conoscenza di base dei metodi di calcolo numerico e analitico.
• Produzione di disegni 2D e modelli 3D: nel rispetto degli standard rilevanti per il dimensionamento e il tolerancing del disegno, in particolare le specifiche del prodotto geometrico ISO (GPS).
• Assemblaggio di strutture e attrezzature meccaniche: conoscenza dei metodi di produzione e processi come la lavorazione, la formazione, l'adesione (ad esempio saldatura, brasatura).

Introduction:
The Engineering Department (EN) pushes forward the limits of technology so that physicists can carry out their research. Within the EN department, the Mechanical and Materials Engineering (MME) Group provides the CERN community with specific engineering solutions combining mechanical design, fabrication, and material sciences.
Are you passionate by mechanics, and are you skilled in computer-aided design? This is an opportunity for you. You will be part of a multidisciplinary project team designing, fabricating and testing a new generation of components for the Future Circular Collider (FCC).
As a Mechanical Technical Engineer in the MME Design Office (EN-MME-MD), you will be in charge of mechanical engineering and design of new complex equipment and mechanical systems for high-energy physics projects and new accelerators and in particular for Superconducting Radio Frequency (SRF) equipment for the FCC.

Structural and thermomechanical studies, design of pressure equipment, cryogenics, ultra-high vacuum technology, sustainable design and manufacturing, safety, reliability, product lifecycle management are just a few of the keywords related to this position.
Functions:

• Technical management of design office activities in collaboration with other services within the EN-MME group and with experts and stakeholders CERN wide, in particular for accelerating cavities within the scope of the FCC project.

• Analysis of design requirements based on functional specifications or other relevant information.

• Execution of design studies of mechanical assemblies, components, tooling, equipment integration and layout.

• Creation of detailed 3D models and technical drawings (including specification, detail, manufacturing, assembly, installation, as-built and verification drawings), in consultation with CERN manufacturing and materials experts and in compliance with relevant design and drafting standards.

• Preparation of the project documentation according to the Design Office quality assurance procedures.

• Preparation of presentations, technical reports, engineering specifications and calculation notes.

• Preparation of technical specification and participation in contract negotiations.

• Follow-up, in close interaction with other teams and services, of the manufacturing, assembling and installation of mechanical components.

• Provide technical oversight and guidance to a team of designers and draftsmen to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with requirements.

• Ensure follow-up of assigned activities using internal administrative tools, including the preparation of estimates, maintenance of job descriptions, and processing of amendments to support timely and accurate invoicing.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience:

• Proven experience as a designer in a mechanical design office, performing mechanical dimensioning and using standard mechanical analysis tools (both analytical and numerical).

• Proven experience with computer-aided design.

• Experience in the production of technical drawings of mechanical components and systems, ideally according to ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS) standards for drawing dimensioning and tolerancing.

• Experience with the CATIA computer-aided-design software suite would be an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Design and construction of machines: ability to analyse and solve mechanical engineering problems using strength of materials and materials selection principles.

• Design and analysis of mechanical structures: with basic knowledge of numerical and analytical calculation methods.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: in compliance with relevant standards for drawing dimensioning and tolerancing, in particular ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS).

• Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: knowledge of manufacturing methods and processes such as machining, forming, joining (e.g. welding, brazing).

• Configuration and use of information management systems: ability to effectively use Computer Aided Design (CAD) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools.
Behavioural competencies:

• Building Relationships: showing a sincere interest in the concerns and perspectives of others.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: demonstrating a willingness to accept changing circumstances supporting initiatives for change.

• Managing Self: taking initiative beyond regular tasks and making things happen.

• Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.

• Working in Teams: supporting and acting in accordance with team decisions; accepting joint responsibility for team successes and shortcomings.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Find out more here .
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 4-5
Job reference: EN-MME-MD-2026-132-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
The CERN Document Server ( CDS ) is CERN's institutional repository, dedicated to archiving, preserving, and disseminating research outputs, multimedia content, and other key documents produced by the organisation. We are building the next-generation web platform based on the open-source technology InvenioRDM, and as a Graduate, you will play a crucial role in shaping its future.
Our ultimate goal is to create a seamless workflow for researchers, enabling them to archive, publish, and share research outputs, including software, data, and documents, more easily and efficiently. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how CERN researchers manage and disseminate their work.
Your responsibilities

• Develop and maintain web applications using Python on the backend and React on the frontend and implement new features to support the archiving, publication, and sharing of research outputs.

• Contribute to the migration of existing content to a new digital platform, ensuring data quality and consistency.

• Write, test, and review code to ensure reliability, performance, and maintainability.

• Collaborate with software engineers and end users to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

• Document technical solutions and contribute to user and developer documentation.

• Learn and apply best practices in software engineering, version control, and agile teamwork.
Your profile

• Experience with Python and web application development (for example using Flask or similar frameworks).

• Basic knowledge of JavaScript and modern web interfaces (for example React or similar libraries).

• Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

• Ability to write clear, maintainable code and learn new technologies.

• Experience with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL.

• Familiarity with search or indexing technologies, such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

• Exposure to container technologies, such as Docker, and container platforms (for example OpenShift).

• Experience contributing to or working with open-source software projects.
Skills

• Python, Flask, JavaScript, React, Git skills are required.

• PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch skills are advantageous.

• Docker, OpenShift skills are advantageous.

• Experience working on open source projects is advantageous.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Software Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-November-2026
Job reference: IT-CA-IR-2026-99-GRAE
Field of work: Software Engineering and IT
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

Durante l'aggiornamento ATLAS Phase-II a Long Shutdown 3, verrà installato un tracker interno all-silicon (ITk) composto da quattro strati di striscia di silicio e cinque strati di pixel ibridi. Il rivelatore fornirà un'eccezionale durezza della radiazione e una veloce ricostruzione delle particelle cariche. Il team CERN ATL-TRK contribuisce alla costruzione del rilevatore di pixel ITk attraverso l'assemblaggio, il test e l'integrazione dei moduli del rilevatore di pixel ibridi e la loro ulteriore integrazione nel rivelatore. Le tue responsabilità
• Assemblare e testare i moduli di rilevamento dei pixel in silicio utilizzati negli esperimenti di fisica delle particelle.
• Supporto e miglioramento dei processi produttivi per raggiungere e mantenere alti livelli di produttività.
• Contribuire ad aumentare la parallelizzazione delle procedure di test in ambienti di laboratorio.
• Sviluppare e mantenere strumenti software interni per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro e analizzare i dati di test.
• Lavora con i database per registrare, monitorare e valutare i risultati delle misurazioni.
• Presenta i progressi e i risultati alle squadre interne e alla più ampia comunità di progetti.
• Assistere nell'aggiornamento di attrezzature e procedure di laboratorio per soddisfare i requisiti di progetto in evoluzione.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con ingegneri, fisici e tecnici in un team multidisciplinare.
• Contribuisci all'integrazione dei moduli di rivelatore assemblati in sottosistemi più grandi del rilevatore ATLAS ITk Pixel. Il tuo profilo
• Esperienza con l'assemblaggio, il collaudo e la caratterizzazione di moduli rivelatori di silicio o sistemi simili.
• Esperienza pratica con strumentazione di laboratorio come stazioni di sonda, sistemi di metrologia, o strumenti di ispezione ottica.
• Capacità di eseguire misurazioni di controllo di qualità e valutare i risultati con attenzione alla precisione e alla ripetibilità.
• Esperienza nell'automazione di procedure di laboratorio e acquisizione dati utilizzando linguaggi di programmazione come Python.
• Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati, strumenti di database e sistemi di documentazione utilizzati nella produzione di rivelatori o in ambienti simili.
• Esperienza di lavoro in grandi collaborazioni di ricerca internazionali e contribuire a infrastrutture comuni o strutture condivise.
• Capacità dimostrata di pianificare, prioritizzare e fornire risultati in tempi stretti in un ambiente di produzione. Competenze
• Conoscenza dei rivelatori di monitoraggio del silicio per esperimenti fisici ad alta energia.
• Esperienza nella gestione di moduli rivelatori di silicio e attrezzature di laboratorio necessarie.
• Esperienza con linguaggi di programmazione comuni come Python.
• Conoscenza dell'analisi dei dati e della valutazione dei moduli per rivelatori di silicio.
• Approccio organizzato, preciso e indipendente al lavoro.
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team multidisciplinari e collaborazioni internazionali.
• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Criteri di ammissibilità:

descriptionByLocale.en:
During the ATLAS Phase-II upgrade in Long Shutdown 3, an all-silicon Inner Tracker (ITk) will be installed, consisting of four silicon strip layers and five hybrid pixel layers. The detector will provide exceptional radiation hardness and fast charged-particle reconstruction. The CERN ATL-TRK team contributes to the ITk pixel detector construction through the assembly, testing, and integration of hybrid pixel detector modules and their further integration into the detector.
Your responsibilities

• Assemble and test silicon pixel detector modules used in particle physics experiments.

• Support and improve production processes to achieve and maintain high throughput levels.

• Contribute to increasing the parallelisation of testing procedures in laboratory environments.

• Develop and maintain in-house software tools to optimise workflows and analyse test data.

• Work with databases to record, track, and evaluate measurement results.

• Present progress and results to internal teams and the wider project community.

• Assist in upgrading laboratory equipment and procedures to meet evolving project requirements.

• Collaborate closely with engineers, physicists, and technicians in a multidisciplinary team.

• Contribute to the integration of assembled detector modules into larger sub-systems of the ATLAS ITk Pixel detector.
Your profile

• Experience with the assembly, testing, and characterisation of silicon detector modules or similar systems.

• Practical experience with laboratory instrumentation such as probe stations, metrology systems, or optical inspection instruments.

• Ability to perform quality control measurements and evaluate results with attention to accuracy and repeatability.

• Experience in automating laboratory procedures and data acquisition using programming languages such as Python.

• Familiarity with data analysis, database tools, and documentation systems used in detector production or similar environments.

• Experience working in large, international research collaborations and contributing to common infrastructure or shared facilities.

• Demonstrated ability to plan, prioritise and deliver results under tight schedules in a production environment.
Skills

• Knowledge of silicon tracking detectors for high energy physics experiments.

• Experience in handling silicon detector modules and required laboratory equipment.

• Experience with common programming languages such as Python.

• Knowledge of data analysis and evaluation for silicon detector modules.

• Organised, accurate and independent approach to work.

• Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and international collaborations.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics or Electronics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

As part of a multidisciplinary team of technicians and engineers, you will be involved in the specification, design, commissioning, and maintenance of a wide range of ICS dedicated to cooling and ventilation plants for accelerator facilities, experimental areas, and technical infrastructure.
This position offers the opportunity to work on large-scale industrial installations in a highly technical and collaborative environment.
Your responsibilities

• Gather control system requirements and compile all relevant technical documentation.

• Design automation solutions and control systems for Industrial ventilation and cooling plants.

• Develop and implement PLC applications for ICS.

• Define and execute tests of ICS on simulators.

• Perform on-site commissioning of ICS.

• Design, implement, and deploy improvements and corrective actions for operational control systems.
More information here .
Your profile

• Proven experience in Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) programming.

• Good knowledge of PLC development based on the IEC 61131 standard.

Introduzione: Il team di coordinamento tecnico ALICE si sta espandendo per affrontare l'aumento del carico di lavoro di ingegneria meccanica associato al programmato Large Hadron Collider (LHC) lunghi periodi di shutdown nel 2026-2028 (LS3) e 2033-2034 (LS4), tra cui attività di decommissione e installazione del rivelatore, lo sviluppo del tutto nuovo rilevatore ALICE 3, e la preparazione di future infrastrutture di rivelatore. In qualità di ingegnere meccanico, contribuirai all'esecuzione delle attività di installazione LS3 e alla progettazione e costruzione del sistema di rilevatori ALICE 3, lavorando in un team multidisciplinare di ingegneri, tecnici e designer. Funzioni:
• Partecipa al programma di aggiornamento del rivelatore ALICE per LS3, in particolare l'installazione del nuovo tubo del fascio, del tracker di silicio e del calorimetro in avanti.
• Fornire supporto tecnico e supervisione in loco presso il sito sperimentale durante i periodi di manutenzione programmati.
• Fornire supporto ingegneristico per il programma di aggiornamento ALICE3 per LS4: definizione del layout degli esperimenti, compresa l'integrazione di rivelatori, servizi e tutte le infrastrutture correlate.
• Rilevatore di design standard strutture metalliche e carbonio-composite, supportate da analisi strutturali per valutare le prestazioni in carichi meccanici, termici e dinamici utilizzando appropriati modelli di materiali e criteri di guasto, garantendo resistenza, stabilità e conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate, compresi gli esperti di rivelatori, i membri della collaborazione, le aziende esterne e i team di supporto tecnico di istituti di collaborazione CERN e ALICE.
• Sostenere il team di coordinamento tecnico ALICE nella supervisione di progettisti e tecnici durante il lavoro quotidiano.

• Esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione e assemblaggio di sistemi meccanici.
• Esperienza dimostrata nell'uso di CATIA per il design CAD.
• Conoscenza degli ANSYS per l'analisi strutturale.
• Esperienza di lavoro in un team multidisciplinare, tra cui la supervisione di tecnici e tecnici.

• Progettazione e analisi delle strutture meccaniche.
• Conoscenza e applicazione della modellazione numerica in meccanica solida.
• Conoscenza e applicazione di compositi non metallici.
• Produzione di disegni 2D e modelli 3D.
• Organizzazione, pianificazione e controllo: , coordinamento delle attività che coinvolgono diversi settori tecnici (lavoro meccanico, strutture metalliche, manipolazione pesante ecc.). Competenze comportamentali:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
The ALICE Technical Coordination team is expanding to address the increased mechanical-engineering workload associated with the scheduled Large Hadron Collider (LHC) Long Shutdown periods in 2026-2028 (LS3) and 2033-2034 (LS4), including detector decommissioning and installation activities, the development of the entirely new ALICE 3 detector, and the preparation of future detector infrastructure.
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the execution of LS3 installation activities and the design and construction of the ALICE 3 detector system, working within a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians, and designers.
Functions:

• Participate in the ALICE detector upgrade programme for LS3, specifically the installation of the new beam pipe, silicon tracker and forward calorimeter.

• Provide mechanical engineering support and on-site supervision at the experiment site during the programmed maintenance periods.

• Provide engineering support for the ALICE3 upgrade programme for LS4: definition of the experiment layout including integration of detectors, services, and all the related infrastructure.

• Design detector standard metallic and carbon-composite structures, supported by structural analyses to assess performance under mechanical, thermal, and dynamic loads using appropriate material models and failure criteria, ensuring strength, stability, and compliance with safety requirements.

• Work closely with stakeholders, including detector experts, collaboration members, external companies and technical support teams from CERN and ALICE collaborating institutes.

• Support the ALICE Technical Coordination team in supervising designers and technicians during the daily work.

• Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience:

• Experience in the design, construction, and assembly of mechanical systems.

• Proven experience in the use of CATIA for CAD design.

• Knowledge of ANSYS for structural analysis.

• Experience working in a multidisciplinary team, including supervision of technical engineers and technicians.

• Proven ability to coordinate work done by external companies and contractors.
Technical competencies:

• Design and analysis of mechanical structures.

• Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.

• Knowledge and application of non-metallic composites.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.

• Organisation, planning and control: , coordination of activities involving different technical fields (mechanical work, metallic structures, heavy handling etc.).
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting

• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily accepting new tasks or work/projects.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 10.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: EP-ALI-TC-2026-127-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
I rilevatori di particelle operanti negli esperimenti del CERN Large Hadron Collider richiedono miscele di gas altamente specifiche, precise e stabili, fornite da sistemi di gas dedicati e complessi spesso operanti nella ricircolo del gas. La composizione corretta e stabile della miscela è un requisito fondamentale per il funzionamento continuo e a lungo termine di tutti i rivelatori. Ti unirai al team Gas Systems nell'EP-DT-GD, responsabile della manutenzione, del funzionamento e dello sviluppo dei sistemi di gas per i rilevatori di particelle. Il team è responsabile di circa 40 sistemi di gas che forniscono le miscele richieste ai rilevatori di particelle in tutti gli esperimenti CERN. In determinate condizioni, i rilevatori di particelle negli esperimenti LHC utilizzano gas serra (GHGs). Il CERN è fortemente impegnato a ridurre le emissioni di GHG dal funzionamento dei rilevatori di particelle. Il team Gas Systems ha individuato quattro strategie per ottimizzare l'utilizzo del GHG: ricircolo del gas, recupero del gas, nuovi gas ecocompatibili e abbattimento del gas. Le tue responsabilità
• Partecipazione attiva al funzionamento, manutenzione e aggiornamenti tecnici dei sistemi di gas per uno degli esperimenti LHC, garantendo un funzionamento continuo e stabile.
• Partecipazione al servizio "piquet" (stand-by duty), fornendo supporto tecnico e rapido intervento per garantire l'affidabilità operativa 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 dei sistemi di gas durante le operazioni di LHC.
• Contributo agli studi R&D finalizzati all'individuazione di sostituzioni per i gas serra attualmente utilizzati (GHGs), come R134a e SF6.
• Contributo e responsabilità per il funzionamento delle configurazioni di prova in laboratorio e nelle strutture del CERN, dove si può simulare lo sfondo ad alta frequenza previsto durante la fase LHC ad alta luminosità.
• Convalida della compatibilità di nuovi gas eco-friendly con i componenti utilizzati nella costruzione del sistema di gas, garantendo nessun impatto sulle prestazioni del rivelatore.
• Imparerai su rivelatori gassosi, sistemi di gas, ricircolo del gas e recupero del gas.
• Questo ruolo include responsabilità di supervisione del team. Il tuo profilo
• Esperienza nel funzionamento di diversi tipi di rivelatori gassosi.
• Esperienza nella progettazione, nel funzionamento o nella manutenzione dei sistemi di gas.
• Conoscenza pratica della strumentazione industriale e dei sensori.
• Esperienza nei rivelatori gassosi operativi in ambienti ad alta velocità e con gas eco-gas.
• Capacità di eseguire interventi tecnici in aree sperimentali. Competenze
• Comprensione del funzionamento del rilevatore di particelle gassoso e degli effetti di radiazione.
• Funzionamento di rivelatori gassosi con miscele di gas.
• Conoscenza dei sistemi di distribuzione del gas.
• Familiarità con tecniche di analisi del gas (cromatografia del gas) e metodi di rilevamento delle perdite.
• Approccio proattivo all'individuazione delle potenziali debolezze del sistema prima che conducano al fermo operativo.
• Capacità e volontà di lavorare in una varietà di ambienti, da laboratori high-tech a caverne sperimentali sotterranee, e di adattarsi alle mutevoli priorità durante le fermate tecniche di LHC e i periodi di presa di dati.
• Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con l'impegno di imparare le basi dell'altra lingua. Criteri di ammissibilità:
• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .
• Hai uno sfondo professionale in fisica o ingegneria (o un campo correlato) e hanno o:
• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;
• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.
• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN. Data di chiusura del lavoro: 10.07.2026 alle 23:59 CEST.
